a: Ketzad ose? manniach emurin al pissat hayyad, vechaze vashok alehen, uvechol makom sheyyesh lechem – hallechem millemala.
Hecha? amar rav pappa: bemilluim.
May tama? illema mishshum dichtiv: "shok hatteruma vachaze hattenufa al ishshe hachalavim yaviu lehanif tenufa", vehachtiv: "et hachelev al hechaze yeviennu"!
Amar abbaye: hahu demayyte leh kohen mibbet hammitbachayim, verame leh.
Vehachtiv "vayyasimu et hachalavim al hechazot"? hahu deyahev leh lechohen acharina, veazel umaktar leh.
Veha ka mashma lan, devaenan shelosha kohanim, mishshum dichtiv: "berov am haderat melech".
Ushete hallechem ushene kivse atzeret [vechulei]. tanu rabbanan: "vehenif hakkohen otam al lechem habbikkurim",
Yachol yanniach kevasim al gabbe hallechem? talmud lomar "al shene kevasim". i "al shene kevasim" yachol lechem al gabbe kevasim? talmud lomar "al lechem habbikkurim".
Nishtakkel hakkatuv, veeni yodea im lechem al gabbe kevasim, veim kevasim al gabbe lechem. ma matzinu bechol makom – lechem lemala, af kan lechem lemala. hecha? amar rav pappa: bemilluim.
Rabbi yose ben hameshullam omer: kevasim lemala, uma ani mekayyem "al shene kevasim" – lehotzi shiva.

Chanina ben chachinay omer: manniach shete hallechem ben yarchotehen shel kevasim umenif, venimtza mekayyem shene mikraot hallalu: lechem al gabbe kevasim, uchevasim al gabbe hallechem. amar rabbi: lifne melech basar vedam en osin ken, lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu osin ken?! ella manniach ze betzad ze umenif.
Veha baenan "al", amar leh rav chisda lerav hamenuna, veamri la rav hamenuna lerav chisda: rabbi letameh, deamar "al" besamuch.

Detanya, "venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka", rabbi omer: "al" besamuch, atta omer "al" besamuch, o eno ella "al" mammash? keshehu omer "vesakkota al haaron et happarochet", heve omer "al" besamuch.
Molich umevi, maale umorid [vechulei]. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: molich umevi – lemi sheharuchot shello, maale umorid – lemi shehashshamayim vehaaretz shello.
Bemareva matnu hachi: amar rav chama bar ukeva, amar rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina: molich umevi – kede laatzor ruchot raot, maale umorid – kede laatzor telalim raim.
Amar rabbi yose bar rav avin: zot omeret sheyare mitzva meakkevim et happureanut, deha tenufa sheyare mitzva hi, veotzeret ruchot raot utelalim raim. amar rabba: vechen lulav.
Rav acha bar yaakov mamte leh umayyte leh, umachve hachi, veamar: "gira beena desitna". velav milleta hi, mishshum deate leitgaroye beh.
Tanu rabbanan: zivche shalme tzibbur teunin tenufa leachar shechita, utenufatan kemot shehen – divre rabbi, vachachamim omrim: bechaze vashok.
Bemay ka mippalgi? amar leh rav chisda lerav hamenuna, veamri la rav hamenuna lerav chisda: bedun minna uminna, bedun minna veoke veatra – ka mippalgi.

Rabbanan savri: dun minna uminna – ma zivche shalme yachid teunin tenufa leachar shechita, af zivche shalme tzibbur teunin tenufa leachar shechita, uminna – ma hatam bechaze vashok, af hacha name bechaze vashok.

Verabbi savar: dun minna veoke veatra – ma zivche shalme yachid teunin tenufa leachar shechita, af zivche shalme tzibbur teunin tenufa leachar shechita, veoke beatra – hatam hu dechaze vashok, aval hacha kemot shehen, kemot shehen bachayyim.
b: Rav pappa amar: dechulle alma dun minna uminna hu, vehayeynu tama derabbi – ki hatam, ma hatam davar shemmattana lechohen, af hacha davar shemmattana lakkohen.
Ravina amar, dechulle alma dun minna veoke veatra, vehayeynu tama derabbanan: "shalmehem" ribbuya hu.
Rabbi shimon omer: shelosha minin teunin shalosh mitzvot, shetayim bechol echad ushelishit en bahen, veellu hen: zivche shalme yachid, vezivche shalme tzibbur, vaasham metzora.

Zivche shalme yachid teunin semicha chayyim, utenufa shechutin, veen bahen tenufa chayyim. zivche shalme tzibbur teunin tenufa chayyim ushechutin, veen bahen semicha. asham metzora taun semicha utenufa chay, veen bo tenufa shachut.

Veyihyu zivche shalme yachid teunin tenufa chayyim, mikkal vechomer: uma zivche shalme tzibbur, sheen teunin semicha chayyim, teunin tenufa chayyim – zivche shalme yachid, shetteunin semicha chayyim, eno din shetteunin tenufa chayyim!
Miet rachamana gabbe zivche shalme tzibbur, "otam", "otam" – lemaote zivche shalme yachid.

Veyihyu zivche shalme tzibbur teunin semicha, mikkal vachomer: uma zivche shalme yachid, sheen teunin tenufa chayyim – teunin semicha, zivche shalme tzibbur shetteunin tenufa chayyim – eno din shetteunin semicha? amar ravina: gemiri shete semichot betzibbur.

Vihe asham metzora taun tenufa shachut, mikkal vechomer: ma zivche shalme yachid sheen teunin tenufa chayyim, teunin tenufa shechutin – asham metzora shettaun tenufa chay, eno din shettaun tenufa shachut!
Miet rachamana gabbe zivche shalme yachid, "oto", "oto" lemaote asham metzora.
Tanu rabbanan: chamishsha sheheviu korban echad – echad menif al yede kullam, vehaishsha – kohen menif al yadah, vechen hashsholeach korbenotav mimmedinat hayyam – kohen menif al yado.

a: Mishna haomer "hare alay bemachavat" – lo yavi bemarcheshet, "bemarcheshet" – lo yavi bemachavat. ma ben machavat lemarcheshet? marcheshet yesh lah kissuy, machavat en lah kissuy, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: marcheshet amukka umaaseha rochashin (rakkin), machavat tzafa umaaseha kashin.
Gemara may tama derabbi yose? illema marcheshet, deatya arichushe hallev, kedichtiv: "rachash libbi davar tov", umachavat, deatya ammachboe happe, kidamri inashe: "menabbach nabboche".
Ema ippecha: machavat, deatya ammachboe hallev, dichtiv "lamma nachbeta livroach"; marcheshet, deatya arichushe [happe], kidamri inashe: "hava merachashan sifvavteh". ella gemara gemiri la.
Rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer kulei. marcheshet amukka – dichtiv "vechol naasa vammarcheshet", machavat tzafa – dichtiv "veal machavat".
Tanu rabbanan: bet shammay omrim: haomer "hare alay marcheshet" yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.
Mesappeka lehu, i al shum keli nikreu, o al shum maasehen.
Uvet hillel omrim: keli haya bammikdash, umarcheshet" shemo, vedome kemin kalbos amok, ucheshebbatzek munnach betocho – dome kemin tappuche habbaratim uchemin bilvate hayyevavnim.
Veomer: "vechol naasa vammarcheshet veal machavat", alma al shum hakkelim nikreu, velo al shum maasehem.
Mishna hare alay betannur – lo yavi maafe chuppach, velo maafe reafim, umaafe yorot haarviyyim. rabbi yehuda omer: ratza – mevi maafe chuppach.
Hare alay minchat maafe – lo yavi mechetza challot umechetza rekikin; rabbi shimon mattir, mippene shehu korban echad.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "maafe tannur", velo maafe chuppach, velo maafe reafim, velo maafe yorot haarviyyim.

Rabbi yehuda omer: "tannur" "tannur" shene peamim, lehacheshir maafe chuppach. rabbi shimon omer: "tannur" "tannur" shene peamim, echad shettehe afiyyaytan betannur, veechad sheyyehe hekdeshan battannur.
Umi it leh lerabbi shimon hay sevara? vehatnan: rabbi shimon omer: leolam heve ragil lomar shete hallechem velechem happanim kesherot baazara, uchesherot bevet page.
Amar rava: ema, sheyyehe hekdeshan leshum tannur.
Hare alay minchat maafe, lo yavi mechetza [vechulei]. tanu rabbanan: "vechi takriv" – keshettakriv, laasot devar reshut.

"Korban mincha" – amar rabbi yehuda: minnayin leomer "hare alay minchat maafe", shello yavi mechetza challot umechetza rekikin? talmud lomar "korban mincha" – korban echad amarti lach, velo shenayim ushelosha korbanot.
Amar lo rabbi shimon:
b: Vechi neemar "korban" "korban" shene peamim? vahalo lo neemar ella korban echad, veneemar bo challot urekikin.
Meatta, ratza lehavi challot – mevi, rekikin – mevi, mechetza challot umechetza rekikin – mevi, uvollan vekometz mishshenehem, veim kamatz veala beyado meechad al shenehem – yatza.

Rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer: minnayin leomer "hare alay minchat maafe", shello yavi mechetza challot umechetza rekikin? talmud lomar: "vechol mincha asher teafe battannur", "vechol naasa vammarcheshet veal machavat lakkohen hammakriv otah lo tihye", "vechol mincha velula vashshemen vachareva lechol bene aharon tihye".
Ma "vechol" haamur lematta shene minin chalukin, af "vechol" haamur lemala shene minin chalukin.
Verabbi yehuda, shappir kaamar rabbi shimon? amar lach: kevan dichtiv "bashshemen" "bashshemen", keman dichtiv "korban" "korban" dame.
Verabbi shimon, i la ketiv "beshemen" "beshemen", hava amena davvka mechetza challot umechetza rekikin, aval challot lechodayyhu urekikin lechodayyhu ema la, ka mashma lan.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hayeynu avu? ikka benayyhu dei avad.
Hadaran alach kol hammenachot.
Mishna rabbi yishmael omer: omer haya ba bashshabbat mishshalosh sein, uvachol mechamesh, vachachamim omrim: echad shabbat veechad chol mishshalosh haya ba.

Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer: bashshabbat haya niktzar beyachid, uvemaggal echad, uvekuppa achat, uvachol – bishlosha, beshalosh kuppot, veshalosh maggalot. vachachamim omrim: echad shabbat veechad chol – bishlosha, beshalosh kuppot, uveshalosh maggalot.
Gemara bishlama rabbanan ka savri: issaron muvechar (bishlosha) [mishshalosh] sein ate, vela shena bechol vela shena beshabbat.
Ella rabbi yishmael, may kasavar? i kasavar: issaron muvechar la ate ella mechamesh – afillu beshabbat name! i mishshalosh ate – afillu bachol name!

Amar rava: kasavar rabbi yishmael, issaron muvechar bela tircha ate mechamesh, betircha ate mishshalosh. bachol mayytinan mechamesh, dehachi shevicha milleta. beshabbat – mutav sheyyarbe bimlacha achat beharekada, veal yarbe bimlachot harebe.

Amar rabba: rabbi yishmael verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka amru davar echad, detanya: arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat – mafshit et happesach ad hechaze, divre rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka. vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyafshit et kullo.
Mi la amar rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hatam, kol hecha deefshar la tarchinan? hacha name, kevan deefshar – la tarchinan.
Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael hacha, ella delekka bizyon kadashim, aval hatam deikka bizyon kodashim,

a: Ema lach kerabbanan sevira leh.

I name, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hatam, ella deitavid leh tzorech gavoah, vela tzerich achole shabbat, aval hacha, dela itavid leh tzorech gavoah, utzerich leachole shabbat – ema kerabbanan sevira leh.

Ella amar rabba: rabbi yishmael verabbi chanina segan hakkohanim amru davar echad, ditnan: rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer: bashshabbat niktzar beyachid, bemaggal echad uvekuppa achat, uvachol – bishlosha, beshalosh kuppot uveshalosh maggalot. vachachamim omrim: echad shabbat veechad chol – beshalosh kuppot uveshalosh maggalot.
Mi la kaamar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim hatam, kevan deefshar – la tarchinan, hacha name, kevan deefshar – la tarchinan.
Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael hacha, ella delekka parsome milleta, aval hatam, deikka parsome milleta – ema kerabbanan sevira leh.

I name, ad kan la kaamar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim hatam, dei bechad i bishlosha – tzorech gavoah mitavid kehilchato, aval hacha, dela itavid kehilchato tzorech gavoah – ema kerabbanan sevira leh.

Ella amar rav ashe: rabbi yishmael verabbi yose amru davar echad, ditnan: ben shennira baalil uven shello nira baalil – mechallelin alav et hashshabbat. rabbi yose omer: im nira baalil – en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat.
Mi la amar rabbi yose hatam, kevan deefshar – la tarchinan, hacha name, kevan deefshar – la tarchinan.
Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael hacha, ella delekka nimtzeta atta machshilan leatid lavo, aval hatam, denimtzeta atta machshilan leatid lavo, ema kerabbanan sevira leh.
I name, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam, ella delekka tzorech gavoah, velo nittena shabbat liddachot, aval hacha, deikka tzorech gavoah, venittena shabbat liddachot – ema kerabbanan sevira leh.

Ittemar: shachat shete chattaot shel tzibbur, veeno tzarich ella achat. amar rabba, veittema rabbi amme: chayyayv al hashsheniyya, ufatur al harishona. vaafillu nitkapper lo bashsheniyya, vaafillu nimtzet rishona kechusha.

Umi amar rabba hachi? veha amar rabba: hayu lefanav shete chattaot, achat shemena veachat kechusha – shachat shemena veachar kach shachat kechusha – chayyayv, kechusha veachar kach shemena – patur, velo od ella sheomrim lo: have shemena lechattechilla ushechot!
Ibbaet ema: semi kechusha mikkammayyta, veibbaet ema: hahi – rabbi amme amra.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: nimtzet harishona kechusha bivne meayin, mahu? batar machshavto azlinan, vegavra leissura ka mikkavven, o dilma batar maasav azlinan?

Amar leh: lav hayeynu derabba verava? deittemar: shama shettava tinok bayyam, ufaras metzuda lehaalot dagim veheela dagim – chayyayv. lehaalot dagim, veheela dagim vetinok – rava amar: chayyayv, verabba amar: patur.
Vead kan rabba la ka patar ella kevan deshama, amrinan name dateh attinok, aval lo shama – la.

Veikka deamri, amar leh: hayeynu pelugetayyhu derabba verava, deittemar: shama shettava tinok bayyam, ufaras metzuda lehaalot dagim veheela dagim – chayyayv, lehaalot dagim veheela tinok vedagim – rabba amar: patur, verava amar: chayyayv. rabba amar patur – zil batar maasav, verava amar chayyayv – zil batar machshavto.
Amar rabba: chole sheamaduhu ligrogeret achat, veratzu asara bene adam veheviu asara gerogrot bevat achat – peturin, afillu beze achar ze, afillu kadam vehivri barishona.

Bae rava: chole sheamaduhu lishte gerogrot, veyesh shete gerogrot bishte uketzin, veshalosh beoketz achat – he minnayyhu mayytinan? shetayim mayytinan, dechazu leh, o dilma shalosh mayytinan, deka memaata ketzira?
Peshita, shalosh mayytinan,
b: Dead kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael hatam, ella dechi memaet baachila ka memaet ketzira, aval hacha dechi ka memaet baachila ka mappesha ketzira, vadday shalosh mayytinan.
Mishna mitzvat haomer lehavi min hakkarov, lo bikker hakkarov lirushalayim – meviin oto mikkol makom. maase shebba haomer miggaggot tzerifin, ushete hallechem mibbikat en socher.
Gemara may tama? ibbaet ema mishshum "karmel".
Veibbaet ema, mishshum deen maavirin al hammitzvot.

Maase shebba [haomer] miggaggot tzerifin. tanu rabbanan: keshetztzaru malche bet chashmonay ze al ze, vehaya hurekanos mibbachutz vaaristobbelus mibbifnim, bechol yom vayom hayu meshalshelin lahen dinarin bekuppa umaalin lahen temidin.

Haya sham zaken echad shehaya makkir bechochmat yevavnit, laaz lahem bechochmat yevavnit, amar lahen: kol zeman sheasukin baavoda en nimsarin beyedchem. lemachar shilshelu lahen dinarin bekuppa, veheelu lahen chazir. kevan shehiggia lachatzi choma, naatz tzippornav bachoma, venizdazea eretz yisrael arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa.
Beotah shaa amru: arur sheyyegaddel chazir, vearur sheyyelammed beno chochmat yevavnit. veal otah shaa shaninu: maase shebba omer miggaggot tzerifin, ushete hallechem mibbikat en socher.

Ki meta omer, la havo yadi mehecha ayyti omer. achruzo, ata hahu charsha, otev chada yeda aiggara vachada yedeh atztzerifa. amar lehu mordochay: mi ikka ducheta dishme "gaggot tzerifin" o "tzerifin gaggot"? bedaku veashkechu.

Ki bae leetoye shete hallechem, la havo yadi mehecha leetoye, achruz. ata hahu gavra charsha, otev yedeh aeneh vachada yeda assichra. amar lehu mordochay: umi ikka ducheta dishme "en socher" o "socher ayin"? bedaku veashkachu.
Hanhu shalosh nashim deayyto shalosh kinnin, chada amra: "lezivati", vachada amra: "leyammati", vachada amra: "leonati".
Sevur minna "zivati" – zava mammash, "leyammati" – leyammati mammash, "leonati" – leonatah, dechullehu chada chattat vachada ola.
Amar lehu mordochay: shemma bezov sikkena, shemma bayyam sikkena, shemma beenah sikkena, dechullehu olot ninhu. beduk veashkuch.

a: Vehayeynu ditnan: petachya al hakkinnin ze mardochay, lamma nikra shemo petachya – sheppoteach devarim vedorshan, veyodea beshivim lashon.

Kullehu sanhedrin name yadi shivim lashon! deamar rabbi yochanan: en moshivim bassanhedrin ella baale chochma, baale mare, baale koma, baale zikna, baale cheshafim, veyodim shivim lashon, shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturegman.
Ella, dahava bayel lishshane vedaresh, vehayeynu dichtiv bemordochay "bilshan".

Mishna ketzad hen osin sheluche bet din yotzin meerev yom tov, veosin otan kerichot bimchubbar lekarka, kede sheyyehe noach liktzor. kol haayayrot hassemuchot lesham mitkannesot lesham, kede sheyyehe niktzar beesek gadol.
Kevan shehechshicha, omer lahen: "ba hashshemesh?" omer: "hen". "ba hashshemesh?" omer: "hen". "maggal zo?" omer: "hen". "maggal zo?" omer: "hen". "kuppa zo?" omer: "hen". "kuppa zo?" omer: "hen".
Bashshabbat, omer lahen: "shabbat zo?" omer: "hen". "shabbat zo?" omer: "hen". "ektzor?" vehem omrim lo: "ketzor". "ektzor?" vehem omrim lo: "ketzor".
Shalosh peamim al kol davar vedavar, vehen omrim lo: hen, hen, hen. kol kach lamma li? mippene habbayytosim, shehayu omrim: en ketzirat haomer bemotzae yom tov.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: illen yomayya dela lehitannaa behon, umiktzathon dela lemispad behon. meresh yarcha denisan ad temanya beh – ittokam temida dela lemispad, umittemanya beh vead sof moada – ittotav chagga deshavuayya dela lemispad.

Meresh yarcha denisan vead temanya beh ittokam temida, dela lemispad – shehayu tzaddukim omrim: yachid mitnaddev umevi tamid. may derush? "et hakkeves haechad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim".
May ahdaru? "et korbani lachmi leishshay tishmeru", sheyyihyu kullan bain mitterumat hallishka.
Mittemanya beh, vead sof moada, ittotav chagga deshavuayya, dela lemispad, shehayu bayytosin omrim: atzeret achar hashshabbat.

Nitpal lahem rabban yochanan ben zakkay, veamar lahem: shotim, minnayin lachem? velo haya adam echad shehaya meshivo, chutz mizzaken echad shehaya mefatpet kenegdo, veamar: moshe rabbenu ohev yisrael haya, veyodea sheatzeret yom echad hu, amad vetikkenah achar shabbat kede sheyyehu yisrael mitannegin shene yamim. kara alav mikra ze: "achad asar yom mechorev derech har seir".
b: Veim moshe rabbenu ohev yisrael haya, lamma icharan bemidbar arbaim shana? amar lo: rabbi, bechach atta potreni? amar lo: shote! velo tehe tora shelema shellanu kesicha betela shellachem!
Katuv echad omer: "tisperu chamishshim yom", vechatuv echad omer: "sheva shabbatot temimot tihyena".
Ha ketzad? kan – beyom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat, kan – beyom tov shechal lihyot beemtza shabbat.
(Shel rabbi eliezer: sofer, rabbi yehoshua: mone, rabbi yishmael: meammer, rabbi yehuda: lematta – siman.)

Rabbi eliezer omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "tispor lach", sefira teluya bevet din, shehem yodim lechaddesh. "mimmochorat hashshabbat" – mochorat yom tov, yatzat shabbat bereshit shessefiratah bechol adam.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: amra tora mene yamim vekaddesh chodesh, mene yamim vekaddesh atzeret. ma chodesh samuch leviato nikkar, af atzeret samuch leviatah nikkeret.
Veim tomar: atzeret leolam achar hashshabbat, heach tehe nikkeret mishshellefaneha?
Rabbi yishmael omer: amra tora have omer bappesach, ushete hallechem baatzeret. ma lehallan – regel utechillat regel, af kan – regel utechillat regel.
Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: neemar "shabbat" lemala, veneemar "shabbat" lematta. ma lehallan – regel, utechillat regel samuch lah, af kan – regel, utechillat regel samuch lah.
Tanu rabbanan: "usefartem lachem", shettehe sefira lechol echad veechad.

"Mimmochorat hashshabbat" – mimmochorat yom tov, o eno ella lemochorat shabbat bereshit? rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: hare hu omer "tisperu chamishshim yom", kol sefirot sheatta sofer lo yehu ella chamishshim yom.

Veim tomar mimmochorat shabbat bereshit, peamim sheatta motze chamishshim veechad, ufeamim sheatta motze chamishshim ushenayim, chamishshim ushelosha, chamishshim vearbaa, chamishshim vachamishsha, chamishshim veshishsha.
Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: eno tzarich,

a: Hare hu omer: "tispor lach", sefira teluya bevet din, yatzta shabbat bereshit shessefiratah bechol adam.

Rabbi yose omer: "mimmochorat hashshabbat" – mimmochorat yom tov. atta omer mimmochorat yom tov, o eno ella mimmochorat shabbat bereshit? amarta: vechi neemar "mimmochorat hashshabbat shebbetoch happesach"? vahalo lo neemar ella "mimmochorat hashshabbat", dechol hashshana kullah melea shabbatot, tze uvedok ezo shabbat.
Veod, neemra "shabbat" lematta, veneemra "shabbat" lemala. ma lehallan – regel utechillat regel, af kan – regel utechillat regel.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: katuv echad omer: "sheshet yamim tochal matztzot", vechatuv echad omer: "shivat yamim matztzot tochelu". ha ketzad? matztza shei atta yachol leochlah shiva min hechadash – atta yachol leochlah shishsha min hechadash.
"Miyyom haviachem ... tisperu" – yachol yiktzor veyavi, veematay sheyyirtze yispor?
Talmud lomar: "mehachel chermesh bakkama tachel lispor". i "mehachel chermesh tachel lispor" – yachol yiktzor veyispor, veematay sheyyirtze yavi? talmud lomar: "miyyom haviachem".
I "miyyom haviachem" – yachol yiktzor veyispor veyavi bayyom? talmud lomar "sheva shabbatot temimot tihyena". ematay atta motze sheva shabbatot temimot? bizman sheatta matchil limnot mibbaerev.
Yachol yiktzor veyavi veyispor ballayla? talmud lomar "miyyom haviachem", ha ketzad? ketzira usefira ballayla, vahavaa bayyom.
Amar rava: kullehu it lehu pircha, bar mittarte tannae batrae, ben bematnita kammayyta ben bematnita batrayyta, delet lehu pircha.
I midderabban yochanan ben zakkay, dilma kidabbaye, deamar abbaye: mitzva lemimne yome, umitzva lemimne shavue.
I midderabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, mimmay divyom tov rishon kae? dilma beyom tov acharon kae!
Derabbi yishmael verabbi yehuda ben betera – let lehu pircha.
I midderabbi yose berabbi yehuda, hava amena: dilma chamshin levar mehane shitta.
I midderabbi yehuda ben betera – mimmay divyom tov rishon kae? dilma beyom tov acharon kae!
Rabbi yose name chaze leh pircha, vehayeynu dekaamar "veod".
Gufa, amar abbaye: mitzva lemimne yome, umitzva lemimne shavue. rabbanan deve rav ashe manu yome umanu shavue, ammemar mane yome vela mane shavue, amar: zecher lammikdash hu.

Mishna ketzaruhu unetanuhu bekuppot, heviuhu laazara, vehayu mehavehavin oto baur, kede lekayyem bo mitzvat kali, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: bekanim uvekolachot chovtin oto, kede shello yitmaech.

Netanuhu leabbuv, veabbuv haya menukkav, kede sheyyehe haur sholet bechullo. shetachuhu baazara, veharuach menashshevet bo. netanuhu lerechayim shel garosot, vehotziu mimmennu issaron, shehu menuppe bishlosh esre nafa, vehashshear nifde veneechol lechol adam, vechayyayv bachalla, ufatur min hammaaser. rabbi akiva mechayyev bachalla uvammaasrot.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "aviv" – ze aviv, "kaluy baesh" – melammed shehayu yisrael mehavehavin oto baesh kede lekayyem bo mitzvat kali, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim:
b: En ur leshon kali ella davar acher (ha ketzad vechulei), en leshon kali ella davar (acher) kalil. ha ketzad? abbuv shel kelayot haya sham, vehaya menukkav kichvara kede shettehe haur sholetet bechullo.
"Aviv kaluy ... geres", eni yodea im "aviv kaluy" im "geres kaluy", keshehu omer "baesh" – hifsik hainyan.

"Karmel" – rach umal, vechen hu omer: "veish ba mibbaal shalisha vayyave leish haelohim lechem bikkurim veesrim lechem seorim vecharmel betziklono vayyomer ten laam veyochelu", ba veyatzak lanu veachalnu, venave haya.
Veomer: "nitallesa boohavim", nisse venitten, venaale, venismach venitchatte boohavim.
Veomer: "kenaf renanim neelasa", nose, ole, venitchatte.
Veomer: "ki yarat hadderech lenegdi" – yareta, raata, natta.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "karmel" – kar male.
Verabbi akiva mechayyev bachalla uvammaasrot. amar rav kahana: omer haya rabbi akiva: meruach hekdesh eno poter.

Metiv rav sheshet: motar shalosh sein hallalu, ma hayu osin bo? nifde veneechol lechol adam, vechayyayv bachalla, ufatur min hammaasrot. rabbi akiva mechayyev bachalla uvammaasrot. amru lo: pode miyyad gizbar yochiach, shechayyayv bachalla ufatur min hammaasrot.
Veim ita demeruach hekdesh eno poter, may kaamri leh? hi hi!
Veod etiveh rav kahana bar tachlifa lerav kahana (bar mattitya): rabbi akiva mechayyev bachalla uvammaasrot, lefi shello nittenu maot ella letzorech lahen.
Ella amar rabbi yochanan: talmud aruch hu befiv shel rabbi akiva, shello nittenu maot ella letzorech lahen.
Amar rava: peshita li demeruach hekdesh poter, vaafillu rabbi akiva la ka mechayyev hatam ella shello nittenu maot ella letzorech lahen, aval meruach hekdesh bealma poter.

Meruach haggoy tannae hi, detanya: tormin mishshel yisrael al shel yisrael, umishshel goyim al shel goyim, umishshel kutiyyim al shel kutiyyim, umishshel kol al shel kol, divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda.

Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: tormin mishshel yisrael al shel yisrael, umishshel goyim al shel kutiyyim, umishshel kutiyyim al shel goyim, aval lo mishshel yisrael al shel goyim veshel kutiyyim, velo mishshel goyim veshel kutiyyim al shel yisrael.

a: Gilgul hekdesh poter, ditnan: hikdishah issatah ad shello gilgela ufedaatta – chayyevet, mishsheggilgela ufedaatta – chayyevet, hikdishah ad shello gilgela, vegilgelah haggizbar veachar kach pedaatta – petura, shebbishat chovatah hayta petura.
Bae rava: gilgul goy may? mitna tenan: ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo issa, naaset ad shello nitgayyer – patur, mishshennitgayyer – chayyayv, safek – chayyayv.
Ha man katane la? divre hakkol hi, vaafillu rabbi meir verabbi yehuda dekamchayyeyvi hatam – patri hacha.
Hatam hu, dichtiv "degancha", "degancha" yattira.
Have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot, afillu goy.
Aval hacha, tere zimne "arisotechem" ketiv, chad "arisotechem" kede issatchem, vechad "arisotechem" velo issat goyim velo issat hekdesh.
O dilma rabbi yose verabbi shimon katane la, deka patri, aval rabbi meir verabbi yehuda gamri "reshit" "reshit" mehatam.
Amar rava: yehe raava deechzeye bechelma. hadar amar rava: man deamar meruach haggoy poter – gilgul haggoy poter, man deamar meruach haggoy eno poter – gilgul haggoy eno poter.
Etiveh rav pappa lerava: goy shehifrish peter chamor vechalla, modiim oto shehu patur, vechallato neechelet lezarim, ufeter chamor gozez veoved bo.
Ha terumato asura, veha hay tanna deamar: meruach haggoy eno poter, vegilgul goy poter.
Veod etiveh ravina lerava: challat goy baaretz, uterumato bechutza laaretz – modiin oto shehu patur, challato neechelet lezarim, uterumato enah medammaat. ha terumato baaretz – asura umedammaat.
Veha hay tanna deamar: meruach haggoy eno poter, gilgul haggoy poter!
Midderabbanan, gezera mishshum baale chisim.
b: I hachi, afillu chala name? efshar deafe lah pachot mechameshet revaim kemach, veod.

Teruma name, efshar deaved la kidrabbi oshaya? deamar rabbi oshaya: maarim adam al tevuato umachnisah bammotz shellah, kede shettehe behemto ochelet ufetura min hammaaser. i name, deayyel la derech gaggot vederech karpefot?
Hatam befarhesya, zila beh milleta; hacha betzina, la zila beh milleta.
Mishna ba lo laissaron, natan alav shamno ulevonato, yatzak uvalal, henif vehiggish, kamatz vehiktir, vehashshear neechol lakkohanim.
Mishshekkarav haomer, yotzin umotzin shuk yerushalayim shehu male kemach kali, shello birtzon chachamim – divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: birtzon chachamim hayu osin.
Gemara vela gazar rabbi yehuda dilma ate lemechal minneh?
Ureminhu: rabbi yehuda omer, bodkin or arbaa asar, uvearbaa asar shacharit, uvishat habbiur, vachachamim omrim: lo badak kulei.
Amar rabba: shane chadash,

a: Mittoch shello hittarta lo ella al yede kittuf, zachur hu.
Amar leh abbaye: tinach ketzira, techina veharekada, may ikka lememar?
Ha la kashya, techina – berichya dida, harekada – al gabbe nafa.
Bet hashshelachin, desharya ketzira, ditnan: kotzrin bet hashshelachin shebbaamakim, aval lo godshin – may ikka lememar?
Ella amar abbaye: chadash – badel minneh, chametz – la badel minneh.
Amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya, derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya?
Ella amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya, kidshannenan. derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya: hu atzmo mechazzer alav lesorfo, mechal achel minneh?!
Rav ashe amar: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya, "kemach kali" tenan.
Veha derav ashe beruta hi, tinach mikkali veelach, ad kali may ikka lememar?
Vechi tema, hacha name al yede kittuf, vechidrabba, bet hashshelachin desharya ketzira may ikka lememar? ella, ha derav ashe beruta hi.
Mishna mishshekkarav haomer huttar chadash miyyad, harchokim muttarin mechatzot hayyom ulehallan. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe yom henef kullo asur.
Amar rabbi yehuda: vahalo min hattora hu asur, shenneemar "ad etzem hayyom hazze", mippene ma harchokim muttarin mechatzot hayyom ulehallan? mippene shehen yodin sheen bet din mitatztzelin bo.
Gemara rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym – omer mattir, bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym – heir mizrach mattir.
May tama? tere kerae ketivi: ketiv "ad yom haviachem", uchetiv "ad etzem hayyom hazze". ha ketzad?
Kan – bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, kan – bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym.
Rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: afillu bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, heir mizrach mattir. vehachtiv: "ad haviachem"! lemitzva.
Mishshekkarav haomer, huttar chadash miyyad! lemitzva.
Haomer haya mattir bammedina, ushete hallechem bammikdash! lemitzva.
b: Mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe yom henef kullo asur. may tama? mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, veyomru: eshtakad mi lo achalnu beheir mizrach? hasheta name nechol!
Vela yadi, deeshtakad la hava omer, heir mizrach mattir, vehasheta deikka omer – omer mattir. vei salka datach lemitzva, mishshum mitzva lekum veligzor?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: rabban yochanan ben zakkay beshitat rabbi yehuda amarah, deamar: min hattora asur, shenneemar: "ad etzem hayyom hazze" –
Ad itztzumo shel yom, vekasavar "ad" vead bakkelal.

Umi savar la kevavteh? veha miflag pelig aleh! ditnan: mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe yom henef kullo asur. amar rabbi yehuda: vahalo min hattora hu asur, dichtiv "ad etzem hayyom hazze"!
Rabbi yehuda hu deka tae, hu savar rabban yochanan ben zakkay midderabbanan kaamar, vela hi, middeorayyta kaamar. veha "hitkin" katane? may "hitkin"? darash vehitkin.
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua achli chadash beureta deshittesar naghe shivsar, kasavri: chadash bechutza laaretz derabbanan, velisfeka la chayyshinan.
Verabbanan deve rav ashe achli betzafra deshivsar, kasavri: chadash bechutza laaretz deorayyta.
Verabban yochanan ben zakkay midderabbanan kaamar, vechi takken leyom henef – lisfeka la takken.
Amar ravina: amra li em – avuch la hava achel chadash ella beureta deshivsar naghe temanesar, desavar la kerabbi yehuda, vechayesh lisfeka.
Mishna haomer haya mattir bammedina, ushete hallechem bemikdash. en meviin menachot, uvikkurim, uminchat behema kodem laomer, im hevi – pasul. kodem lishte hallechem lo yavi, im hevi – kasher.
Gemara yatev rabbi tarfon veka kashya leh: ma ben kodem laomer lekodem shete hallechem?
Amar lefanav yehuda bar nechemya: lo, im amarta kodem laomer, shekken lo huttar mikkelalo etzel hedyot, tomar kodem lishte hallechem, shehuttar mikkelalo etzel hedyot?

Shatak rabbi tarfon, tzahavu panav shel rabbi yehuda ben nechemya, amar lo rabbi akiva: yehuda, tzahavu panecha sheheshavta et zaken? temehani im taarich yamim. amar rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: oto happerek peros happesach haya, keshealiti laatzeret shaalti acharav: yehuda ben nechemya hechan hu? veamru li: niftar vehalach lo.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ledivre yehuda ben nechemya, nesachim bikkurim shehikrivam kodem laomer – kesherin. peshita!
Mahu detema: hatam hu dehuttar mikkelalo etzel hedyot, aval hacha delo huttar mikkelalo – la. ka mashma lan: kol shekken hacha, dela ittesar kelal.
(Seder hanatza gele pil siman.) bae rame bar chama: shete hallechem mahu sheyyattiru shello kesidran?
Hechi dame? kegon dezarinhu ben haomer lishte hallechem, vachalef alayyhu shete hallechem veomer. may? kesidran sharyayn, shello kesidran la sharyayn? o dilma shello kesidran name sharyayn.
Amar rabba: ta shema, "veim takriv minchat bikkurim" – beminchat haomer hakkatuv medabber. mehechan baa? min hasseorin. atta omer min hasseorin, o eno ella min hachittin?
Rabbi eliezer omer: neemar "aviv" bemitzrayim, veneemar "aviv" ledorot. ma "aviv" haamur bemitzrayim – seorin, af "aviv" haamur ledorot – seorin.
Verabbi akiva omer: matzinu yachid shemmevi chovato min hachittin, vechovato min hasseorin.
Vetzibbur shemmeviin chovatan min hachittin, meviin chovatan min hasseorin, veim atta omer ba min hachittin – lo matzinu tzibbur shemmevi chovato min hasseorin.
Davar acher: im atta omer omer ba min hachittin – en shete hallechem "bikkurim".
Veim ita dishte hallechem shello kesidran sharyayn, mashkachat la demakrev omer mehanach deashrush kodem lishte hallechem, uvatar haomer deeshtakad.
Ushete hallechem mehanach deashrush kodem laomer dehashta, uvatar shete hallechem deeshtakad.
Mi savrat

a: Bikkurim lefera ka amrinan? lemizbeach ka amrinan! veha achel le mizbeach mippere deha shatta.
Bae rame bar chama: shete hallechem – hanatza sharya, o chanata sharyay? may hanatza, umay chanata? illema hanatza defera vachanata defera – hasheta hasherasha sharya, hanatza vachanata mibbaya?
Ella, hanatza deale vachanata deale, mi have ki hasherasha o la? teku.
Bae rava bar rav chanan: chittin shezzeraan bakkarka, omer mattiran o en omer mattiran? hechi dame? i deashrush – tenena, i dela ashrush – tenena.
Ditnan: im hishrishu kodem laomer – omer mattiran, veim lav – asurin ad sheyyavo omer habba.

La tzericha, dechatzdinhu vezarinhu kodem laomer, vaata omer vachalef alayyhu, veka mibbaya leh: mahu lenakkote umechal minnayyhu? keman deshadyay bechadda damya, usherinhu omer, o dilma battel lehu legabbe ara?
Yesh lahen onaa, o en lahen onaa?

Hechi dame? ilema deamar leh: sheday ba shitta, vaato sahadi veamri dela sheda ba ella chamsha – vehaamar rava: kol davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan, afillu pachot mikkede onaa chozer!
Ella, daamar leh: sheday ba kidvae la, vaato sahadi veamri dela sheda ba kidvae la. yesh lahen onaa, dichman deshadyay bechadda damya veyesh lahen onaa, o dilma battel lehu legabbe ara?
Nishbain alehen, o en nishbain alehen? kidshadyay bechadda damya, uchemittaltele damu, venishbain alehen, o dilma battel lehu aggav ara, vechimkarkee damu, veen nishbain alehen? teku.

Bae rame bar chama: chittin shebbegelle vakar, useorin shebbegelle vehema – mahu? lemay? ilema letammoye tumeat ochalin – tenena: chittin shebbiri vakar useorin shebbegelle vehema, chishshev alehen laachila – en mittamme tumeat ochalin, likketan laachila – metamme tumeat ochalin.
Ella limnachot, peshita dela, "hakerivehu na lefechatecha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha"!

La tzericha, denaktinhu vezarinhu, veka vae leetoye menachot minnayyhu. may? mishshum dimisuta hu, vechevan dezarinhu azda (lameaysavetayyhev) [meisutayyhu], o dilma mishshum kechishuta hu, vehasheta name kechusha? teku.
Bae rame bar chama: pil shebbala kefifa mitzrit, vehekiah derech bet hari, mahu? lemay?
Illema lemivtal tumeata, tenena: kol hakkelim yordin lide tumeatan bemachshava, veen olin mittumeatan ella beshinnuy maase.
La tzericha, divla hutzin veavdinhu kefifa mitzrit. mi have ikkul, have leh
b: Kichle gelalim, kichle adama, veen mekabbelin tumea – deamar mar: kele avanim uchele gelalim uchele adama en mekabbelin tumea lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim, o dilma la have ikkul?
Tifshot leh meha deamar ulla mishshum rabbi shimon bar yehotzadak: maase uvalu zeevim shene tinokot beever hayyarden, uva maase lifne chachamim, vetiharu et habbasar.
Shane basar, derakkich. velifshot missefa: vetimmeu et haatzamot! shane atzamot, daakoshe tefe.
Bae rabbi zera: chittin sheyyardu beavim, mahu? lemay? i limnachot – ammay la? ella lishte hallechem, may?
"Mimmoshvotechem" amar rachamana, leappoke dechutza laaretz dela, aval deavim shappir dame; o dilma "mimmoshvotechem" davvka, vaafillu deavim name la.
Umi ikka ki hay gavvna? in, kedaadi tayyaya, nechita leh rum kizva chitte bitlata parse.

Bae rabbi shimon ben pazzi: shibbolet shehevia shelish kodem laomer, vaakarah ushetalah leachar haomer, vehosifa – mahu? batar ikkar azlinan vesharyay omer, o dilma batar tosefet azlinan, vead sheyyavo omer habba?
Tifshot leh meha deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: yalda shessibbechah bizkena, uvah perot, afillu hosif bematayim – asur.
Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, amar rabbi yonatan: batzal sheshshetalo bakkerem, veneekar hakkerem, afillu hosif bematayim – asur.
Hi gufa ka mibbaya leh: mifshat peshita lehu lerabbanan devatar ikkar azlinan, la shena lekulla vela shena lechumera? o dilma sappoke mesappeka lehu, ulechumera amrinan, lekulla la amrinan? teku.
Bae rabba: leinyan maaser may? hechi dame? kegon

a: Deamdinhu veasserinhu veshatlinhu (vehosifa) [veosifa] lehu.
Im timtza lomar, la azlinan batar ikkar, vetosefet bae assore – ikkar may? amar leh abbaye: may shena mikkol chitte useare dealma?
Amar leh: davar shezzaro kale – la mibbaya li, ella ki kamibbaya li – davar sheen zaro kale, may?
Tifshot leh meha deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: litra batzal shettikkeno uzerao – mitasser lefi kullo.
Hatam – hayeynu zeriato, hacha – lav hayeynu zeriato.
Amar leh rabbi chanina bar minyome leabbaye: atzitz sheeno nakuv, mahu? i lo nakuv – ha lo nakuv!
Dilma chazar unekavo, ka amrat?
Hacha, chada zeria hi, ichabbore hu deka michabbera veola; hatam – shete zeriot ninhu.
Bae rabbi avahu: shibbolet shemmerchah bichri, ushetalah, vekara aleha shem bimchubbar – mahu? kevan demerchah tavla la, ki kara aleha shem kadsha la, o dilma, kevan deshatla – peka leh tivla minna.
Amri leh rabbanan leabbaye: im ken, matzinu teruma bimchubbar lakkarka, utenan: lo matzinu teruma bimchubbar lakkarka!
Amar leh: ki tanya hahi – leinyan ichayyove mita vachomesh, dei talesh veachel – talush hu, vei gachen veachel – batla dato etzel kol adam.
Umay shena middichtav appinaksa deilfa: betze nivlat haof hattahor, miktzatan bachutz umiktzatan bifnim – mibbifnim metammein begadim abbet habbelia, mibbachutz en metammein begadim abbet habbelia.
Talush – avidi inashe deachli hachi, bimchubbar – la avidi inashe deachli.
Amar rav tavyome bar kisna, amar shemuel: hazzorea kilayim beatzitz sheeno nakuv – asur. amar abbaye: bishlama i ashmeinan loke makkat mardut midderabbanan – shappir, ella asur – may ka mashma lan?
Demidderabbanan havya zeria? tenena: taram mishsheeno nakuv al hannakuv – teruma, veyachzor veyitrom.

Mishna hachittin, vehasseorin, vehakkussemin, vehashshibbolet shual, vehashshifon – hare ellu chayyayvin bachalla, umitztarfin ze im ze, vaasurim bechadash millifne happesach, umilliktzor millifne haomer. im hishrishu kodem laomer – haomer mattiran, veim lav – asurin ad sheyyavo haomer habba.
Gemara tana: kussemin – min chittim, shibbolet shual veshifon – min seorin. kussemin –
b: Guleba, shifon – dishra, shibbolet shual – shuvle taala. hane – in, orez vedochan – la.
Mena hane mille? amar resh lakish: atya "lechem" "lechem" mimmatztza. ketiv hacha: "vehaya baacholchem millechem haaretz", uchetiv hatam: "lechem oni".

Vehatam gufa menalan? amar resh lakish, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael, vechen tana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: amar kera "lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot lechem oni" – devarim habbaim lide chimmutz adam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach, yatzu ellu sheen bain lide chimmutz ella lide serachon.
Umitztarfin ze im ze. tana: hattevua vehakkemachim vehabbetzekot mitztarfin ze im ze. lemay hilcheta?
Amar rav kahana: leinyan chadash. rav yosef amar: leinyan chametz bappesach. rav pappa amar: leinyan maaser sheni, dei achel leh chutz lachoma – lake.
Rava amar: leinyan tumeat ochalin, veha ka mashma lan: ditvua ukemachin dumeya divtzekot – ma hatam uchela beeneh, af hacha name uchela beeneh.
Vehatanya: chitta, ben kelufa ben sheenah kelufa – mitztarefet; seora, kelufa – mitztarefet, sheenah kelufa – en mitztarefet.
Ini? veha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea" – kederech shebbene adam motziin lizria: chitta biklippatah, useora biklippatah, vaadashim biklippatan.
La kashya, ha belachot, ha biveshot.
Vaasurin bechadash millifne happesach, mena hane mille? amar resh lakish: atya "lechem" "lechem" mimmatztza.
Veliktzor lifne haomer, mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan: atya "reshit" "reshit" mechalla.
May kodem laomer? rabbi yona amar: kodem ketzirat haomer, rabbi yose bar zavda amar: kodem havaat haomer.
Tenan: asurin bechadash lifne fesach, veliktzor lifne haomer. bishlama leman deamar kodem havaat haomer – hayeynu dela ka arev lehu vetane lehu.
Ella leman deamar kodem ketzirat haomer, liarvinhu velitninhu: asurin bechadash veliktzor lifne happesach!
Ella, i ittemar – assefa ittemar: im hishrishu kodem laomer – haomer mattiran. may kodem laomer? rabbi yona amar: kodem havaat haomer, rabbi yose bar zavda omer: kodem ketzirat haomer.
Amar leh rabbi elazar

a: Lerabbi yoshiyya dedareh: la tetev akkaraycha ad dimfarshat leh leha matnitin, minnayin laomer shemmattir behasherasha?
Menalan? dichtiv "aviv", lav mikkelal deikka delav "aviv"?
Delav "aviv", uleolam deayyel shelish.
Ella amar shemuel: "mehachel chermesh", lav mikkelal deikka delav bar chermesh? delav bar chermesh, uleolam shachat.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: "kama" – lav mikkelal delav bar kama? delav bar kama, uleolam agam.
Ella amar rava: "asher tizra" – mishsheat zeria. amar leh rav pappa lerava: i hachi, af al gav delo hishrish name? amar leh: sudani, "bassade" ketiv.

Mishna kotzrin bet hashshelachin shebbaamakim, aval lo godshin. anshe yericho kotzrin birtzon chachamim, vegodshin shello birtzon chachamim, velo michu beyadam. kotzer leshachat, maachil labbehema. amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bizman shemmatchil ad shello hevi shelish. rabbi shimon omer: yiktzor veyaachil af mishshehevi shelish.
Vekotzrin mippene netiot, mippene bet haevel, mippene bittul bet hammidrash. lo yaase otan kerichot, aval mannichin tzevatim.
Mitzvat haomer lavo min hakkama. lo matza – yavi min hoomarim. mitzvato lavo min hallach, lo matza – yavi yavesh. mitzvato liktzor ballayla, niktzar bayyom – kasher. vedoche et hashshabbat.
Gemara tanya: rabbi binyamin omer, katuv echad omer: "uketzartem et ketzirah vahavetem et omer", uchetiv: "reshit ketzirchem el hakkohen".
Ha ketzad? mimmakom sheatta mevi – i atta kotzer, mimmakom shei atta mevi – atta kotzer.
Ema: mimmin sheatta mevi – i atta kotzer, mimmin shei atta mevi – atta kotzer? hahu la matzet amrat, midderabbi yochanan.
Anshe yericho kotzrin birtzon chachamim, vegodshin shello birtzon chachamim vechulei. man shamat leh deamar "michu" velo michu"? rabbi yehuda.
Vesavar rabbi yehuda ketzira deanshe yericho birtzon chachamim havay? veha tanya: shishsha devarim asu anshe yericho, shelosha birtzon chachamim, ushelosha shello birtzon chachamim.

Veellu shebbirtzon chachamim: markivin dekalim kol hayyom, vechorchin et "shema", vekotzrin lifne haomer – birtzon chachamim. veellu shello birtzon chachamim: godshin lifne haomer, umattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma, ufortzin peratzot begannotehen vvfardesotehen lehaachil nesher laaniyyim bishne vatztzoret beshabbatot uveyamim tovim, divre rabbi meir.
Amar lo rabbi yehuda: im birtzon chachamim hen osin, yehu kol adam osin ken! ella ellu vaellu shello birtzon chachamim, veal shelosha michu beyadam, veal shelosha lo michu beyadam.
Veellu shello michu beyadam: markivin dekalim kol hayyom, vechorchin et "shema", vekotzrin vegodshin lifne haomer. veellu shemmichu beyadam:
b: Mattirin gamziyyot shel hekdesh shel charuv veshel shikma, ufortzin peratzot begannotehen uvefardesotehen kede lehaachil nesher laaniyyim bishne vatztzoret beshabbatot uveyamim tovim, venotnin pea layyarak, umichu beyadam.
Velitamaych, shishsha? shiva havu! ella semi mikkan ketzira.

Kotzer leshachat umaachil labbehema. tenan hatam: veellu mafsikin lappea – hannachal, vehashshelulit, vederech hayyachid, vederech harabbim, ushevil harabbim, ushevil hayyachid hakkavua bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim, vehabbor, vehannir, vezera acher.
Vekotzer leshachat mafsik, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim omrim: en mafsik ella im ken charash.
Amar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi meir beshitat rabbi shimon amarah, deamar: yiktzor veyaachil af mishshehevia shelish, alma kasavar kol leshachat lav ketzira hi.

Yatev rabba vekaamar la leha shemata, etiveh rav acha bar huna lerava: achalah chagav, karsemuha nemalim, shibberattaho haruach – hakkol modim charash mafsik, lo charash eno mafsik. "hakkol modim" – man? rabbi meir.
I amrat bishlama matnitin beshello hevia shelish, barayyta decharash – in, lo charash – lo, beshehevi shelish.
Ella i amrat matnitin name beshehevi shelish, hasheta uma hatam diktzira dehatam amar rabbi meir: lo shemah ketzira, hacha – lo kol shekken?
Ella, rabbi meir beshitat rabbi yehuda amarah, deamar: ematay? bizman shehitchil ad shello hevi shelish, aval im hitchil ad shehevi shelish – asur.
Emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda livhema, leadam mi shamat leh? deim ken, havu lehu telata tannae.

Ella, ki ata rav dimi amar: rabbi meir beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo amar, af leadam name la havya ketzira. ditnan: hamenammer sade veshiyyer bo kelachim lachim, rabbi akiva omer: pea lechol echad veechad.
Vachachamim omrim: meechad al hakkol, veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo chiyyev rabbi akiva ella bimnammer liklayot, aval bimnammer laotzar – lo.
Ini? veha ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: mechayyev haya rabbi akiva af bimnammer laotzar.

a: Savar la kevavteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Kotzrin mippene hannetiot, umippene bet haevel, umippene bet hammidrash. may tama? "ketzirchem" amar rachamana, velo ketzir mitzva.
Velo yaase kerichot, aval mannichan tzevatim. may tama? dechamma deefshar la tarchinan.

Mitzvat haomer lehavi min hakkama. tanu rabbanan: "veim takriv minchat bikkurim", ma talmud lomar? lefi shemmitzvat haomer lehavi min hakkama, minnayin sheim lo matza min hakkama yavi min hoomarin? talmud lomar "takriv".

Davar acher: "takriv" – lefi shemmitzva lehavi min hallach, uminnayin sheim lo matza min hallach yavi min hayyavesh? talmud lomar "takriv". davar acher: "takriv" – lefi shemmitzvato liktzor ballayla, minnayin sheim niktzar bayyom kasher? talmud lomar "takriv".
Vedocha et hashshabbat, talmud lomar "takriv", "takriv" – kol shehu, "takriv" – mikkol makom, "takriv" – vaafillu beshabbat, "takriv" – vaafillu betumea.

Niktzar bayyom – kasher. vehatnan: kol hallayla kasher liktzirat haomer, ulehaktir chalavim veevarim. ze hakkelal: davar shemmitzvato kol hayyom – kasher kol hayyom, davar shemmitzvato belayla – kasher kol hallayla.
Katane layla dumeya deyom, ma deyom – ballayla la, af delayla – bayyom name la.

Amar rabba: la kashya, ha rabbi, veha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon. detanya: haya omed umakriv minchat haomer venitmet, im yesh acheret – omer lo: "have acheret tachteha", veim lav – omer lo: "heve pikkeach ushetok", divre rabbi.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: ben kach uven kach, omar lo: "heve pikkeach ushetok", shekkol haomer shenniktzar shello kemitzvato – pasul.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi elazar berabbi shimon beshitat rabbi akiva rabbo shel aviv amarah, ditnan: kelal amar rabbi akiva: kol melacha sheefshar lo laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat.
Vesavar la kerabbi yishmael, deamar ketzirat haomer mitzva, ditnan: rabbi yishmael omer: ma charish reshut, af katzir reshut, yatza ketzir haomer shehi mitzva.
Vei salka datach niktzar shello kemitzvato kasher, ammay dache shabbat? niktzereh meerev shabbat! ella middedache shabbat, shema minna: niktzar shello kemitzvato – pasul.
Verabbi, lav talmideh derabbi shimon hu?

Vehatanya, amar rabbi: keshehayinu lemedin tora etzel rabbi shimon bitkoa, hayinu maalin lo shemen vaalunetit mechatzer legag, umiggag lekarpef, umikkarpef lekarpef acher, ad sheanu maggiin lemayayn sheanu rochatzin bo.
Savar la keiddach derabbi shimon, detanya: amar rabbi shimon: bo uree kamma chaviva mitzva bishatah, shehare hekter chalavim veevarim kesherim kol hallayla, velo haya mamtin lahen ad shettechshach.
b: Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon la shemia leh?!
Ella shane hatam, shehare dachata shechita et hashshabbat.
Ulerabbi, hachi name dachata shechita et hashshabbat! ella kasavar rabbi: ketzirat haomer la dachaya shabbat.
Vela? vehatnan: vachachamim omrim, echad shabbat veechad chol – mishshalosh haya ba. dela kerabbi.
Vachachamim omrim: echad shabbat veechad chol – bishlosha, beshalosh kuppot uveshalosh maggalot – dela kerabbi.
Uveshabbat yomar lahem "shabbat zo?" – dela kerabbi!
Niktzar bayyom kasher, vedoche et hashshabbat. man shamat leh deamar: niktzar bayyom kasher? rabbi, vekatane: vedoche et hashshabbat. may lav ketzira? lo, lehakerava.

Aval liktzira la? vehatanya: rabbi omer: "vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shello lamadnu ella letamid ufesach, shenneemar bahen "bemoado", "bemoado" – vaafillu beshabbat, "bemoado" – vaafillu betumea.
Shear korbenot hatztzibbur minnayin? talmud lomar: "elle taasu laAdonai bemoadechem".
Minnayin lerabbot omer, vehakkarev immo? shete hallechem, vehakkarev immahen? talmud lomar: "vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai" – hakkatuv kava moed lechullan.
Lemay? ilema lehakerava – shete hallechem bene hakerava ninhu?
Ella peshita litchina veharekada, vedichvata gabbe omer liktzira, veka dache et hashshabbat.
Ella, omer lehakerava, ushete hallechem laafiyya, vekasavar rabbi tannur mekaddesh, i afe la meetmol – ippesila la belina.
Vesavar rabbi tannur mekaddesh? vehatanya: kivse atzeret en mekaddeshin et hallechem ella bishchita. ketzad? shechatan lishman, vezarak daman lishman – kadash hallechem.
Shechatan shello lishman, vezarak daman shello lishman – lo kadash hallechem. shechatan lishman, vezarak daman shello lishman – hallechem kadosh veeno kadosh, divre rabbi.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: leolam eno kadosh, ad sheyyishchot lishman veyizrok daman lishman.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hukebu velo hukebu ka amar.
Hadaran alach rabbi yishmael.

Mishna veellu menachot nikmatzot, usheyarehen lakkohanim: minchat hassolet, vehammachavat, vehammarcheshet, vehachallot, veharkikin, minchat goyim, uminchat nashim, uminchat haomer, uminchat chote, uminchat kenaot.
Rabbi shimon omer: minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet, vekometz karev leatzmo, veshirayim kerevim leatzman.
Gemara amar rav pappa: kol hecha ditnan – eser tenan, may ka mashma lan?
Leappoke merabbi shimon, deamar: mechetza challot umechetza rekikin yavi, ka mashma lan dela.
Usheyarehen lakkohanim, menalan? dichtiva – ketiva, udela ketiva – ketiv ba: "vezot torat hammincha hakerev otah bene aharon vegomer vehannoteret mimmenna yochlu aharon uvanav".
Baa chittin – la kamibbaya lan, ki ka mibbaya lan – baa seorin. baa seorin name, middenikmetzet – sheyareha lakkohanim.
Allibba derabbanan, la ka mibbaya lan; ki ka mibbaya lan – allibba derabbi shimon, deamar: ikka mincha demikkamtza vela mitachla.
Ditnan: rabbi shimon omer: minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet, hakkometz karev beatzmo, vehashshirayim kerevin beatzman. menalan?

Amar chizkiyya: deamar kera "vechol mincha velula vashshemen vachareva lechol bene aharon tihye". im eno inyan livlula shel chittin – tenehu inyan livlula shel seorin, veim eno inyan lachareva shel chittin – tenehu inyan lachareva shel seorin.
Vehay lehachi hu daata? ha mibbee leh lechidtanya: minnayin sheen cholkin menachot keneged zevachim –

a: Talmud lomar: "vechol hammincha asher teafe battannur lechol bene aharon tihye ish keachiv".

Yachol lo yachleku menachot keneged zevachim, shello kamu tachtehen bedallut, aval yachleku menachot keneged ofot, shehare kamu tachtehen bedallut – talmud lomar: "vechol naasa bammarcheshet lechol bene aharon tihye".

Yachol lo yachleku menachot keneged ofot, shehallalu mine damim vehallalu mine kemachim, yachleku ofot keneged zevachim, shehallalu vehallalu mine damim – talmud lomar: "veal machavat lechol bene aharon tihye".

Yachol lo yachleku ofot keneged zevachim, shehallalu asiyyaytan bayyad, vehallalu asiyyaytan bichli, aval yachleku menachot keneged menachot, sheellu vaellu asiyyaytan bayyad – talmud lomar: "vechol mincha velula vashshemen ... lechol bene aharon tihye".

Yachol lo yachleku machavat keneged marcheshet, umarcheshet keneged machavat, shezzo maaseha kashin vezo maaseha rakkin, aval yachleku machavat keneged machavat umarcheshet keneged marcheshet – talmud lomar: "vachareva lechol bene aharon tihye".
Yachol lo yachleku bekodshe kadashim, aval yachleku bekadashim kallim – talmud lomar: "ish keachiv", "veim al toda" – keshem sheen cholkin bekodshe kadashim, kach en cholkim bekadashim kallim.
"Ish" – ish cholek, vaafillu baal mum, veen katan cholek, vaafillu tam.
Hahu mikkol" nafka, veha appekteh lechidrabbi yose berabbi yehuda? ella, hahu mivchol".
Ravina amar: atya middetane levi, detane levi: "lechol korbanam ulechol minchatam ulechol chattatam ulechol ashamam".
"Kol korbanam" – lerabbot log shemen shel metzora, salka datach amena: "min haesh" ketav rachamana, ka mashma lan.

"Lechol minchatam" – lerabbot minchat haomer uminchat kenaot, salka datach amena: "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem" amar rachamana, vehay lehattir ka atya, veiddach name levarer ka atya – ka mashma lan.
"Lechol chattotam" – lerabbot chattat haof, salka datach amena: nevela hi, ka mashma lan.
"Lechol ashamam" – lerabbot asham nazir vaasham metzora. asham metzora – behedya ketiv beh: "ki kachattat haasham hu lakkohen"!
Ella, lerabbot asham nazir kaasham metzora. salka datach amena: lehacheshir ka ate, ka mashma lan.
"Asher yashivu" – ze gezel hagger, "lecha hi ulevanecha" – shellecha hi ulevanecha, afillu lekaddesh bo et haishsha.
Amar rav huna:
b: Shalme haggoy – olot, ibbaet ema kera, veibbaet ema sevara. ibbaet ema sevara – goy libbo lashshamayim.
Veibbaet ema kera, "asher yakrivu laAdonai leola" – kol dimkarvi ola leheve.
Metiv rav chama bar gureya: goy shehitnaddev lehavi shelamim, netanan leyisrael – yisrael ochlan, netanan lechohen – hakkohen ochlan.
Amar rava: hachi ka amar, al menat sheyyitkapper bahen yisrael – yisrael ochlan, al menat sheyyitkapper bahen kohen – kohen ochlan.
Metiv rav shezvi: ellu menachot nikmatzot usheyarehen lakkohanim – minchat goyim. amar rabbi yochanan: la kashya, ha rabbi yose haggelili, ha rabbi akiva.
Detanya: "ish", ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot et haggoyim shennodrin nedarim unedavot keyisrael.
"Asher yakrivu laAdonai leola" – en li ella ola, shelamim minnayin? talmud lomar "nidrehem". toda minnayin? talmud lomar "nidvotam".
Minnayin lerabbot haofot, vehayyayin, vehallevona, vehaetzim? talmud lomar "nidrehem", "lechol nidrehem", "nidvotam", "lechol nidvotam".
Im ken ma talmud lomar "ola", "ola" – perat linzirut, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: "asher yakrivu laAdonai leola" – en li ella ola bilvad.
Vehay perat linzirut, mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka, "dabber el bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir" – bene yisrael nodrin, veen haggoyim nodrim.
I mehatam – hava amena: korban hu dela layyte, aval nezirut chala alayyhu, ka mashma lan.

Keman azla ha ditnan, amar rabbi shimon: shiva devarim hitkinu bet din, veze echad mehen: goy sheshshillach olato mimmedinat hayyam veshillach immah nesacheha – kerevin mishshello, veim lav – kerevin mishshel tzibbur.
Lema rabbi yose haggelili, vela rabbi akiva! afillu tema rabbi akiva, ola vechol (chavyrata) [avzaraha].
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: "ezrach" – ezrach mevi nesachim, veen haggoy mevi nesachim. yachol lo tehe olato teuna nesachim? talmud lomar "kacha". manni? la rabbi yose haggelili vela rabbi akiva.
I rabbi yose haggelili – ha amar afillu yayin name! i rabbi akiva – ha amar: ola – in, midde acharina – la.
Ibbaet ema: rabbi yose haggelili, veibbaet ema: rabbi akiva. ibbaet ema: rabbi yose haggelili – semi mehahi "yayin", veibbaet ema: rabbi akiva – ola vechol (chavyrata) [avzaraha].
Rabbi shimon omer: minchat chote shel kohanim [vechulei]. mena hane mille?
Detanu rabbanan: "vehayta lakkohen kammincha", shettehe avodatah keshera bo.
Atta omer shettehe avodatah keshera bo, o eno ella lehattir minchat chote shel kohanim, uma ani mekayyem "vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel"? minchat nidvato, aval chovato tehe neechelet.

Talmud lomar "vehayta lakkohen kammincha", makkish chovato lenidvato: ma nidvato enah neechelet – af chovato enah neechelet. amar rabbi shimon: vechi neemar "vehayta lakkohen keminchato"? vahalo lo neemar ella "kammincha"! ella lehakkish

a: Minchat chote shel kohanim keminchat chote shel yisrael – ma minchat chote shel yisrael nikmetzet, af minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet.
I ma minchat chote shel yisrael nikmetzet usheyareha neechalin, af minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet usheyareha neechalin?
Talmud lomar "lakkohen kammincha", lakkohen kammincha, velo laishshim kammincha. ha ketzad? kometz karev beatzmo, veshirayim kerevin beatzman.
Ha shettehe avodatah keshera bo, mehacha nafka?
Mehatam nafka, minnayin lakkohen shebba umakriv korbenotav bechol et uvechol shaa sheyyirtze? talmud lomar: "uva bechol avvat nafsho vesheret".
I mehatam, hava amena: hane mille – davar sheen ba al chet, aval davar shebba al chet – ema la.
Veha name mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "vechipper hakkohen al hannefesh hashshogeget becheta vishgaga", melammed shehakkohen mitkapper al yede atzmo!
I mehahu, hava amena: hane mille – beshogeg, aval bemezid – la, ka mashma lan.
Bemezid, hechi mashkachat la? bizdon shevua.

Tanya iddach, rabbi shimon omer: minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet, vehakkometz karev bifne atzmo, vehashshirayim kerevin bifne atzman. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: hakkometz karev beatzmo, vehashshirayim mitpazzerin al bet haddeshen.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: have ba rabbi yochanan, bet haddeshen dehecha? i dilmala – hayeynu avu, i dilmatta – yesh lecha davar shekkarev lematta?
Amar leh rabbi abba: dilma leibbud? achichu aleh, vechi yesh lecha davar shekkarev leibbud?
Tane avu derabbi avin: "kol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel" – laachila hikkashtiha, velo ledavar acher.
May ka amar? amar abbaye: hachi ka amar – "kol minchat kohen ... lo teachel" – chovato, "kalil tihye" – nidvato. amar leh rava: sakkina charifa mafseka kerae!
Ella amar rava: "kol minchat kohen kalil tihye" – nidvato, "lo teachel" – chovato.
Veefoch ana? mistabbera nidvato hava leh lerabboye, shekken tedira, la chate, besim recheh.
Adderabba, chovato hava leh lerabboye, shekken issaron chova! hanach nefishan.
Verabbanan, hay "kol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel", may avdi leh?
Mibbee lehu lechidtanya: en li ella elyona bechalil toktar", vetachtona belo teachel".
Minnayin litten et haamur shel ze baze, veet haamur shel ze baze? talmud lomar "kalil" "kalil" ligzera shava: neemar kan "kalil", veneemar lehallan "kalil",
Ma lehallan bechalil toktar", af kan bechalil toktar". uma kan litten lo taase al achilato, af lehallan litten lo taase al achilato.
Bae ravina: kohen sheachal min haemurin, ma hu? lav dezarut
b: La ka mibbaya li, ki ka mibbaya li lav dechalil tihye", may?
Amar rav aharon leravina: ta shema detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: kol shehu bechalil tihye", litten lo taase al achilato.

Mishna minchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachim – lammizbeach, veen bahen lakkohanim. uvaze yippa koach mizbeach mikkoach hakkohanim. shete hallechem velechem happanim – neechalin lakkohanim, veen bahem lammizbeach. uvaze yippa koach hakkohanim mikkoach hammizbeach.
Gemara vetu lekka? veha ikka ola! ikka orah lakkohanim. veha ikka olat haof! ikka murea venotza. veha ikka nesachim! leshitin azli.
Umay "bazo"? leappoke middishmuel, deamar shemuel: hammitnaddev yayin mevio umezallefo al gabbe ishshim, ka mashma lan dilshitin azli.
Mesayyay leh lishmuel, deamar shemuel: hammitnaddev shemen – komtzo, usheyarav neechalin.
Shete hallechem velechem happanim, vetu lekka? veha ikka chattat haof! ikka damah.
Vehaikka log shemen shel metzora! ikka mattenotav.
Umay "bazo"? leappoke mimman deamar: shete hallechem habbaot bifne atzman lisrefa atyayn, kamashma lan devazo yippa koach kohanim leolam.
Mishna kol hammenachot hannaasot bichli, teunot shelosha mattanot shemen: yetzika, uvelila, umattan shemen bichli kodem laasiyyaytan.
Challot bollan, divre rabbi, vachachamim omrim: solet. hachallot teunot belila, urekikin – meshicha. ketzad moshchan? kemin ki, vehashshear neechalin lakkohanim.
Gemara lemaote may? amar rav pappa: lemaote minchat maafe.
Tanu rabbanan: "veim minchat marcheshet korbanecha solet bashshemen tease", melammed shetteuna mattan shemen bichli. "korbanecha" "korbanecha" ligzera shava,

a: Ma kan – mattan shemen bichli, af lehallan – mattan shemen bichli. uma lehallan – yetzika uvelila, af kan yetzika uvelila.
Challot – bollan, divre rabbi, vachachamim omrim: solet.

Tanu rabbanan: "solet belula", melammed shennivlelet solet. rabbi omer: challot bollan, shenneemar: "challot belulot". amru lo: vahalo lachme toda neemar bahen "challot", vei efshar levollan keshehen challot, ella solet!
Ketzad ose? noten shemen bichli kodem laasiyyaytan, venotnah, venoten shemen aleha uvollah, velashah, veofah, ufottah, venoten aleha shemen, vekometz.

Rabbi omer: challot bollan, shenneemar: "challot belulot bashshemen". ketzad ose? noten shemen bichli kodem laasiyyaytah, venotnah, velashah, veofah, ufottah, venoten aleha shemen, uvollah, vechozer venoten aleha shemen, vekometz.
"I efshar" dekaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi, may hi? amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: reviit shemen hi, heach mitchalleket lechamma challot?

Hachallot teunot belila, urekikin meshicha. tanu rabbanan: "challot belulot", velo rekikin belulin. sheyyachol vahalo din hu: uma challot sheenan teunot meshicha – teunot belila, rekikin shetteunin meshicha – eno din shetteunin belila! talmud lomar: "challot belulot" – velo rekikin belulin.

"Rekikin meshuchin", velo challot meshuchot. sheyyachol – vahalo din hu: uma rekikin sheenan teunin belila – teunin meshicha, challot shetteunot belila – eno din shetteunot meshicha! talmud lomar "rekikin meshuchim" – velo challot meshuchot.
May talmuda? amar rava: la lishtemit velichtov "challot meshuchot urekikin belulin".
Ketzad moshchan? kemin ki, vehashshear neechol vechulei. may "kemin ki"? amar rav kahana: kemin ki yevavni.
Tanu rabbanan: mincha habbaa mechetza challot umechetza rekikin, mevi log shemen, vechotzehu – chetzyo lachallot vechetzyo larkikin.

Vechallot bollan, urekikin moshchan, umosheach et harakik al pene kullo, ushear hashshemen machziro lachallot. rabbi shimon ben yehuda mishshum rabbi shimon omer: moshchan kemin ki, ushear hashshemen neechol lakkohanim.

Tanya iddach: rekikin habbaim bifne atzman, mevi log shemen umoshchan, vechozer umoshchan, ad sheyyichle kol shemen shebballog. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: moshchan kemin ki, ushear hashshemen neechol lakkohanim.
Mishna kol hammenachot hannaasot bichli teunot petita.
Gemara lemaote may? amar rav pappa: lemaote shete hallechem velechem happanim.
Tanu rabbanan: "patot otah pittim mincha" – lerabbot kol hammenachot liftita. yachol sheani merabbe af shete hallechem velechem happanim? talmud lomar: "otah".
"Veyatzakta ... shamen mincha" – lerabbot kol hammenachot litzika. yachol sheani merabbe af minchat maafe? talmud lomar "aleha shamen".
Otzi et hachallot velo otzi et harkikin? talmud lomar "hi". may talmuda? ema lehotzi minchat kohanim!
b: Amar rabba: ezehu davar shetztzarich shene miutin? heve omer zo minchat maafe.

Mishna minchat yisrael – kofel echad lishnayim, ushenayim learbaa, umavdil. minchat kohanim – kofel echad lishnayim, ushenayim learbaa, veeno mavdil. minchat kohen mashiach – lo haya mekappela. rabbi shimon omer: minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach en bahen petita, mippene sheen bahen kemitza, vechol sheen bahen kemitza – en bahen petita. vechullan pottan kezetim.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "patot" – yachol lishnayim? talmud lomar "pittim". i "pittim" – yachol yaasenna perurin? talmud lomar "otah" – otah liftitim, velo petita liftitim.

Ha ketzad? minchat yisrael – kofel echad lishnayim ushenayim learbaa umavdil. minchat kohanim vechohen mashiach – haya mekappela vechulei. veha anan tenan: lo haya mekappela! amar rabba: eno mekappela learbaa, aval mekappela lishnayim.

Rabbi shimon omer: minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach en bahen petita. amar rav yosef: hay chavitza deit ba perurin kezayit – mevarchinan aleh "hammotzi lechem min haaretz", i let ba perurin kezayit – mevarchinan aleh "bore mine mezonot".

Amar rav yosef: mena amena la? detanya: haya omed umakriv menachot birushalayim, omer: "baruch shehecheyaynu vekiyyemanu", netalan leochlan omer: "hammotzi lechem min haaretz", utenan: vechullan petitim bichzayit.
Amar leh abbaye: uletanna deve rabbi yishmael, deamar mefarchan ad shemmachziran lesoltan, hachi name dela mevarech "hammotzi"?
Vechi tema hachi name, vehatanya: likket mikkullan kezayit vaachalo, im chametz hu – anush karet, im matztza hu – adam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach.
Hacha bemay askinan? besheersan.
I hachi, hayeynu dekatane ala: vehu sheachalan bichde achilat peras, vei besheersan – "sheachalo" mibbee leh! ella hacha bemay askinan? beva millechem gadol.
May have ala? rav sheshet amar: afillu perurin sheen bahen kezayit. amar rava: vehu deikka torita denahma alayyhu.

a: Mishna kol hammenachot teunot shelosh meot shifa vachamesh meot beita, shifa uveita bachittin. verabbi yose omer: babbatzek. kol hammenachot baot eser eser, chutz millechem happanim vachavitte kohen gadol shehem baot shetem esre, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: kullam baot shetem esre, chutz mechallot toda unezirut shehen baot eser eser.
Gemara tana: shaf achat, boet shetayim. shaf shetayim, boet shalosh. bae rabbi yirmeya: amtoye veetoye chad, o dilma amtoye veetoye tere? may? teku.
Shifa uveita bachittin, rabbi yose omer: babbatzek. ibbaya lehu: babbatzek velo bachittin, o dilma af babbatzek? ta shema, detanya: shifa uveita bachittin, rabbi yose omer: shifa uveita babbatzek.
Kol hammenachot baot kulei. shetem esre lechem happanim – behedya ketiv beh.
Chavitte kohen gadol – atya "chukka" "chukka" millechem happanim.
Kol hammenachot devaot eser eser, menalan? gamar millachme toda – ma lehallan eser, af kan eser. velelaf millechem happanim – ma lehallan shetem esre, af kan shetem esre!
Mistabbera millachme toda hava leh lemelaf, shekken yachid, hammitnaddev, shemen, nifsal, shello beshabbat, veshello betumea.
Adderabba, millechem happanim hava leh lemelaf, shekken hekdesh, ulevona, matztza, vaetzem!
Hanach nefishan.
Vei sevira lan davar hallamed bigzera shava chozer umelammed bevinyan av, nelaf mechavitte kohen gadol: ma lehallan – shetem esre, af kan – shetem esre?
Mistabbera millachme toda hava leh lemelaf, shekken hedyot shehitnaddev chatzain;
Lefiggul, shello beshabbat, veshello betumea.
Adderabba, mechavitte kohen gadol hava leh lemelaf, shekken issaron, keli hekdesh, ulevona;
Matztza vaetzem, haggasha veishshim, vehane nefishan.
Hedyot mehedyot adif leh.
Rabbi meir omer: kullan baot shetem esre. may kasavar? i sevira leh dedavar hallamed bigzera shava chozer umelammed bevinyan av – yalef mechavitte (dechohen) [chohen] gadol, dehane nefishan.
I sevira leh dedavar hallamed bigzera shava eno chozer umelammed bevinyan av – yalef millechem happanim, hekdesh mehekdesh adif leh.
Chutz millachme toda unezirut, shehen baot eser eser. lachme toda – behedya ketiv behu.
Nezirut – deamar mar: "shelamav" – lerabbot shalme nazir.
Amar rav tovi bar kisna, amar shemuel: lachme toda sheafaan arba challot – yatza. veha baenan arbaim lemitzva!
Veha bae afroshe teruma minnayyhu! vechi tema demafresh mikkol chada vachada – "echad" amar rachamana, shello yittol parus, deafreshinhu belesha.
Metivi: kol hammenachot sheribba bemiddat challatan, o shemmiet bemiddat challatan – kesherot, chutz millechem happanim, vachavitte kohen gadol, velachme toda unezirut! hu
b: Deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: kol hammenachot sheribba bemiddat challatan, o shemmiet bemiddat challatan – kesherot, chutz millechem happanim vachavitte kohen gadol, veyesh omrim: af lachme toda unezirut.
Amar rav huna: minchat maafe (shaafa) [sheafaah] challa achat – yatza. may tama? (matztzot) "matztzat" ketiv.

Matkef la rav pappa: tama dichtiv "matztzat", ha ketiv "matztzot" – la? veha gabbe lachme toda dichtiv "matztzot", veamar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel: lachme toda sheafaan arba challot – yatza! hahi peliga.
Mishna haomer haya ba issaron mishshalosh sein, shete hallechem shete esronim mishshalosh sein, lechem happanim esrim vearba esronim meesrim vearba sein.
Gemara may tama? kevan demechadash ate, umisseorin ate, issaron muvechar la ate ella mishshalosh sein.
Shete hallechem shete esronot mishshalosh sein – kevan demechittin atyayn, af al gav demechadash atyayn, shete esronot atu mishshalosh sein.
Lechem happanim esrim vearbaa esronot meesrim vearbaa sein – may tama? kevan demechittin atu, umiyyashan atu, issaron muvechar ate missea.
Tanu rabbanan: kol hammenachot sheribba bemiddat esronan, o shemmiet bemiddat issaron – pesulot. ribba bemiddat sein shellahen, o shemmiet bemiddat sein shellahen – kesherot.

Mishna haomer haya menuppe bishlosh esre nafa, shete hallechem bishtem esre, velechem happanim beachat esre. rabbi shimon omer: lo haya lahen kitzva, ella solet menuppa kol tzorkah haya mevi, shenneemar: "velakachta solet veafita otah", ad shettehe menuppa kol tzorkah.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: bedakka begassa, bedakka begassa. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: shelosh esre nafot hayu bammikdash, zo lemala mizzo vezo lemala mizzo, elyona koletet subbin, tachtona koletet solet.
Rabbi shimon omer: lo haya lahen kitzva. tanu rabbanan: "solet veafita otah" – melammed shennikkachat solet.
Uminnayin sheafillu chittin? talmud lomar "velakachta" – mikkol makom. yachol af bishar menachot ken? talmud lomar "otah", mippene hachissachon.
Amar rabbi elazar: may "mippene hachissachon"? amar rabbi elazar: hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael. hecha remiza? dichtiv: "vehishkita et haeda veet beiram".
Hadaran alach ellu menachot nikmatzot.
Mishna hattoda hayta baa chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot, shehen shesh midbariyyot. shete efot, haefa shalosh sein, esrim issaron – asara lechametz vaasara lammatztza.

a: Asara lechametz – issaron lechalla, vaasara lematztza – uvematztza shalosh minin: challot, rekikin, urevucha. nimtzeu shelosha esronim ushelish lechol min umin, veshalosh challot leissaron.

Uvemidda yerushalmit hayu sheloshim kav, chamishsha asar lechametz vachamishsha asar lematztza. chamishsha asar lechametz – kav umechetza lechalla, chamishsha asar lematztza. uvematztza shalosh minin: challot, urekikin, urevucha. nimtzeu chameshet kabbin lechol min umin, ushete challot lekav.
Gemara hattoda hayta baa chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot. mena hane mille? amar rav chisda: deamar kera "haefa vehabbat tochen echad yihye (lachem)". ma bat shalosh sein, af efa shalosh sein.
Uvat gufa menalan? illema middichtiv "laset (et) masar hachomer habbat", efa name hachtiv "vaasirit hachomer haefa"! ella chomer la yadana kamma, hacha name la yadana kamma.
Ella mehacha: "vechok hashshemen habbat hashshemen umasar habbat min hakkor aseret habbattim chomer ki aseret habbattim chomer".
Amar shemuel: en mosifin al hammiddot yoter mishshetut, velo al hammatbea yoter mishshetut, vehammistakker lo yistakker yoter mishshetut.
May tama? illema mishshum afkoe tara – i hachi, shetut name la!
Ella mishshum onaa, ki hechi dela leheve bittul mikkach, veha amar rava: kol davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan, afillu pachot mikkede onaa – chozer!
Ella mishshum taggara, ki hechi dela limteyeh deyana. deyana hu dela limteyeh, revacha la bae? zeven vezabben – taggara ikkeri?!
Ella amar rav chisda: shemuel kera ashkach uderash, "hashshekel esrim gera esrim shekalim chamishsha veesrim shekalim asara vachamishsha shekel hammane yihye lachem", mane matan vearbein havu.
Ella shema minna telat: shema minna mane shel kodesh kaful haya, ushema minna mosifin al hammiddot veen mosifin yoter mishshetut, ushema minna shetuta millevar.
Amar ravina: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: toda hayta baa chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot shehen shesh midbariyyot, shema minna.
b: Mishna mikkullam haya notel echad measara teruma, shenneemar: "vehikriv mimmennu echad mikkol korban teruma laAdonai", "echad" – shello yittol parus, "mikkol korban" – sheyyehu kol hakkarbanot shavin, shello yittol mikkorban al chavero. "lakkohen hazzorek et dam hashshelamim lo yihye", vehashshear neechol labbealim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehikriv mimmennu" – min hamechubbar, "echad" – shello yittol parus, "mikkol korban" – sheyyehu kol hakkarbanot (shavot) [shavivyn], shello yittol min hakkorban al chavero, "teruma laAdonai" – eni yodea mikkamma hi,
Hareni dan: neemar kan "teruma", veneemar bitrumat maaser "teruma", ma lehallan echad measara, af kan echad measara.
O kelach lederech zo: neemar kan "teruma", veneemar bevikkurim "teruma", ma lehallan en lah shiur, af kan en lah shiur.
Nire lemi dome: danin teruma sheen achareha teruma, mitteruma sheen achareha teruma, veal yochiach bikkurim, sheyyesh acharehen teruma.
O kelach lederech zo: danin teruma hanneechelet bemakom kadosh, mitteruma hanneechelet bemakom kadosh, veal tochiach terumat maaser, shenneechelet bechol makom.
Talmud lomar "mimmennu teruma laAdonai", uchetiv bitrumat maaser "mimmennu teruma" – ligzera shava.

Lamadnu litruma shehi echad measara, aval eni yodea mikkamma hi challa. hareni dan: neemar kan "lechem", veneemar lehallan bishte hallechem "lechem", ma lehallan issaron lechalla, af kan issaron lechalla.
O kelach lederech zo, neemar kan "lechem", veneemar belechem happanim "lechem", ma lehallan shene esronot, af kan shene esronot.
Nire lemi dome? danin mincha habbaa chametz im hazzevach, mimmincha habbaa chametz im hazzevach, veal yochiach lechem happanim, sheeno ba chametz im hazzevach.

O kelach lederech zo, danin mincha habbaa mearetz vechutza laaretz, min hechadash umin hayyashan, mimmincha habbaa mearetz vechutza laaretz, min hechadash umin hayyashan, veal yochichu shete hallechem, sheen baot ella min hechadash umin haaretz.

Talmud lomar "mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa shetayim", sheen talmud lomar "taviu", uma talmud lomar "taviu"? shekkol ma sheatta mevi mimmakom acher hare hu kaze, ma lehallan issaron lechalla af kan issaron lechalla.
I ma lehallan shene esronot, af kan shene esronot? talmud lomar "tihyena".
Lamadnu asara lechametz, asara lematztza minnayin? talmud lomar "al challot lechem chametz".
Neged chametz, have matztza. nimtzeu esrim esronot lachme toda, asara lechametz, vaasara lematztza.

Yachol asara shebbematztza lo yehu kullan ella mimmin echad? talmud lomar "im al toda yakrivennu vehikriv al zevach hattoda challot matztzot belulot bashshemen urekike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen solet murbechet vegomer". nimtzeu shelosha esronim ushelish lechol min umin, veshalosh challot leissaron, venimtzeu lachme toda arbaim. notel mehen arba venoten lechohen, vehashshear neechalim labbealim.
Amar mar: "vehikriv mimmennu" – min hamechubbar. ella meatta, dichtiv "veet kol chelbo yarim mimmennu" – hatam may mechubbar ikka?
Kidrav chisda amar avimi, deamar rav chisda amar avimi: shello yenatteach basar kodem sheyyittol emurin.
Amar mar: neemar kan "teruma", veneemar bitrumat maaser "teruma".
Venelaf mitterumat midyan? danin teruma hannoheget ledorot mitteruma hannoheget ledorot, veal tochiach terumat midyan sheenah noheget ledorot.

Venelaf mitterumat challa? tana deve rabbi yishmael: danin davar shenneemar bo "mimmennu terumat Adonai" middavar shenneemar bo "teruma laAdonai", leappoke terumat challa delo neemar bo "mimmennu teruma laAdonai".
Bae rava: terumat lachme toda, chayyayvin alehen mita vachomesh, o en chayyayvin alehen mita vachomesh?
Kevan deittakkash litrumat maaser, kitrumat maaser dame, o dilma "bo" vachamishshito" miet rachamana?
Medammaat, o enah medammaat? teku.
Amar mar: talmud lomar "tihyena". may talmuda?

a: Amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: "tihyena" ketiv. ema asara kefize? amar rava: beesronot dibber hakkatuv.
Lamadnu asara lechametz. asara lematztza minnayin? talmud lomar "al challot lechem chametz", keneged chametz have matztza.
Vechi davar hallamed behekkesh, chozer umelammed behekkesh? hemennu vedavar acher hu, vechol hemennu vedavar acher – la have hekkesh.
Hanicha leman deamar la have hekkesh, ella leman deamar have hekkesh, may ikka lememar? "taviu" ribbuya hi.
Mishna hammilluim hayu bain kammatztza shebbattoda – challot, urekikin, (urevicha) [urevucha].
Nezirut hayta baa shete yadot kematztza shel toda, challot urekikin, veen bah revucha, nimtza asara kabbin yerushalmit, shehen shishsha esronot veodyin.

Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav chisda, amar rav chama bar gureya: deamar kera "umissal hammatztzot asher lifne Adonai lakach challat matztza achat vechallat lechem shemen achat verakik echad". bishlama "challot" – challot, "rakik" – rakik, "shemen" may ninhu? lav revucha.
Matkef la rav avya: ema anta demishcha! ella, kiddaresh rav nachman bar rav chisda mishshemeh derabbi tavla: "ze korban aharon uvanav asher yakrivu laAdonai beyom himmashach oto".
Vechi ma lamadnu levanav beyom himmashcho? ella makkish chinnucho lehimmashcho: ma himmashcho revucha, af chinnucho revucha.
Amar rav chisda: kohen gadol hammitkarev laavoda tzarich shete esronot haefa, achat lehimmashcho, veachat lechinnucho. mar bar rav ashe amar: shalosh.
Vela peligi, ha – daavad avoda keshehu kohen hedyot, ha – dela avad avoda keshehu kohen hedyot.
Nezirut hayta baa shete yadot, kammatztza shebbattoda.
Tanu rabbanan: "shelamav" – lerabbot shalme nazir, laaseret kabbin yerushalmiyyot velirviit shemen.
Yachol lechol ma sheamur bainyan, talmud lomar "matztzot".

May talmuda? amar rav pappa: davar shenneemar bo "matztzot", leappoke revucha delo neemar bo "matztzot". deve rabbi yishmael tana: "matztzot" – kalal, "challot urekikin" – parat, kelal uferat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat, challot urekikin – in, midde acharina – la.
b: Mishna hashshochet et hattoda lifnim velachmah chutz lachoma – lo kadash hallechem. shechatah ad shello karmu paneha battannur, vaafillu karmu kullan chutz meechad mehen – lo kadash hallechem.
Gemara may "chutz lachoma"? rabbi yochanan amar: chutz lechomat bet page, veresh lakish amar: chutz lechomat haazara.
Resh lakish amar: chutz lechomat haazara, baenan "al" besamuch.
Verabbi yochanan amar: chutz lechomat bet page, aval chutz laazara – kadosh, vela baenan "al" besamuch.
Veha ippeligu ba chada zimna?

Ditnan: hashshochet et happesach al hechametz – over belo taase. rabbi yehuda omer: af hattamid. veamar resh lakish: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyehe o lashshochet, o lazzorek, o leechad mibbene chavura – immo baazara. verabbi yochanan amar: af al pi sheen immo baazara.
Tzericha, dei ittemar behahi – behahi ka amar rabbi yochanan, dechol hecha deiteh beissura kae, aval leinyan mikdash lechem – ema mode leh leresh lakish dei iteh bifnim – kadosh, abbaray – lo kadosh.
Vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar resh lakish, aval behach ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan, tzericha.
Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: hashshochet et hattoda lifnim, velachmah chutz lechomat bet page – lo kadash hallechem.
Shechatah ad shello karmu paneha battannur.

Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "al challot lechem chametz yakriv korbano al zevach" – melammed sheen hallechem kadosh ella im ken karmu paneha battannur. "yakriv korbano al zevach" – melammed sheen hallechem kadosh ella bishchitat hazzevach. "zevach todat" – melammed sheim shachat shello lishman lo kadash hallechem.
Tanu rabbanan: yotzin bematztza na, uvematztza haasuya beilpas. may matztza na? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol shepporsah veen chutin nimshachin hemenna.
Amar rava: vechen leinyan lachme toda, peshita! hacha "lechem" ketiv, vehacha "lechem" ketiv.
Mahu detema: "echad" amar rachamana – shello yittol parus, veha keman difrisa damya, kamashma lan.
