Ittemar, toda sheshshechatah al shemonim challot: chizkiyya amar: kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim, verabbi yochanan amar: lo kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim.

Amar rabbi zera: hakkol modim, hecha deamar "likdeshu arbaim mittoch shemonim" – kadshu, "al yikdeshu arbaim ella im ken yikdeshu shemonim" – lo kadshu. ki peligi bistama, mar savar: leachrayut ka mikkavven, umar savar: lekorban gadol ka mikkavven.

Abbaye amar: dechulle alma leachrayut ka mikkavven, uvichle sharet mekaddeshin shello middaat ka mippalgi. mar savar: kele sharet mekaddeshin shello middaat, umar savar: kele sharet en mekaddeshin shello middaat.

Rav pappa amar: dechulle alma kele sharet mekaddeshin shello middaat, vehacha besakkin ka mippalgi – mar savar: sakkin mekaddeshet kichli sharet, umar savar: sakkin, kevan delet leh toch, enah mekaddeshet kichli sharet.

Veikka deamri, rav pappa amar: dechulle alma kele sharet en mekaddeshin ella middaat, vehacha besakkin ka mippalgi. mar savar: sakkin allima mikkeli sharet, deaf al gav delet lay toch – meykaddesha, umar savar: sakkin la allima (lay) mikkeli sharet.
Mishna shechatah chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah – kadash hallechem, shechatah venimtzet terefa – lo kadash hallechem.
Shechatah venimtzet baalat mum, rabbi eliezer omer: kadash, vachachamim omrim: lo kadash.
Shechatah shello lishmah, vechen el hammilluim, vechen shene kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman – lo kadash hallechem.
Gemara – matnitin manni? rabbi meir.

Detanya, ze hakkelal: kol sheppissulo kodem shechita – lo kadash hallechem; pissulo achar shechita – kadash hallechem. shechatah chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah – kadash hallechem; shechatah venimtzet terefa – lo kadash hallechem.

a: Shechatah venimtzet baalat mum – rabbi eliezer omer: kadash, rabbi yehoshua omer: lo kadash, divre rabbi meir.

Amar rabbi yehuda: lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al sheshshechatah venimtzet terefa – shello kadash, veal chutz lizmanno – shekkadash, veal baal mum – shello kadash. veal ma nechleku? al chutz limkomo, sherabbi eliezer omer: kadash, verabbi yehoshua omer: lo kadash.

Amar rabbi eliezer: hoil vechutz lizmanno pasul, vechutz limkomo pasul, ma chutz lizmanno – kadash, af chutz limkomo – kadash. amar rabbi yehoshua: hoil vechutz limkomo pasul, uvaal mum pasul, ma baal mum – lo kadash, af chutz limkomo – lo kadash.
Amar lo rabbi eliezer: ani dimmitihu lechutz lizmanno, veatta dimmito levaal mum, nire lemi dome – im dome lechutz lizmanno, nedunennu mechutz lizmanno, im dome levaal mum, nedunennu mibbaal mum.
Hitchil rabbi eliezer ladun: danin pesul machshava mippesul machshava, veen danin pesul machshava mippesul hagguf.

Hitchil rabbi yehoshua ladun: danin pesul sheen bo karet, mippesul sheen bo karet, veal yochiach chutz lizmanno, sheppesul sheyyesh bo karet. veod, nedunennu mishshello lishmo, sheppesul machshava veen bo karet.
Veshatak rabbi eliezer.
Verabbi meir, may shena shechatah venimtzet terefa, dehave pesulo kodem shechita, umay shena shechatah venimtzet baalat mum, dela have pesulo kodem shechita?
Bedukkin shebbaayin, veallibba derabbi akiva, deamar: im alu lo yerdu. verabbi yehoshua: ki amar rabbi akiva im alu lo yerdu – bifsula degufeh, aval lekaddoshe lechem – la.
Ittemar: chattat sheshshechatah chutz lizmannah, im alta – lo tered. chutz limkomah, rava amar: tered, rabba amar: lo tered.
Rava kerabbi yehoshua, verabba kerabbi eliezer.
Vahadar beh rabba legabbeh derava, middahadar beh rabbi eliezer legabbeh derabbi yehoshua.

Veikka deamri: af al gav dahadar beh rabbi eliezer legabbeh derabbi yehoshua, rabba legabbeh derava la hadar beh. hatam hu dekaamar leh: nedunennu mishshello lishmo, aval hacha, i dayynat leh mishshello lishmo – im alta lo tered.
Shechatah shello lishmah [vechulei]. amar rav pappa: shevak tanna didan el nazir dishchiach, venaket el hammilluim? vetanna didan – ikkar milleta naket.
Mishna hannesachim shekkadshu bichli venimtza zevach pasul, im yesh zevach acher – yakrivu immo, veim lav – yippaslu belina.
Gemara amar zeeri: en hannesachim mitkaddeshin ella bishchitat hazzevach. may tama? amar kera: "zevach unesachim".
Tenan: hannesachim shekkadshu bichli venimtza zevach pasul – im yesh zevach acher, yikrevu immo; veim lav – yippaslu belina.
May lav deippesil bishchita? la, deippesil bizrika.
Keman? kerabbi, deamar: shene devarim hammattirin maalin ze belo ze.
Afillu tema rabbi elazar berabbi shimon, hacha bemay askinan – kegon shekkibbel daman bechos venishpach.
b: Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar la kevavteh daavu, deamar: kol haomed lizrok kezaruk dame.

Amar mar: im yesh zevach acher yikrevu immo, veha amar rav chisda: shemen shehifrisho leshum mincha zo – pasul leshum mincha acheret! amar rabbi yannay: lev bet din matne alehem, im hutzerchu – hutzerchu, veim lav – yehu lezevach acher.
I hachi, shemen name? shemen gufa demincha hu.
Velaytno alehen denippeku lechullin? gezera shemma yomru: motziin mikkele sharet lachol.
Hasheta name, gezera shemma yomru: nesachim shehifrishan leshum zevach ze – kesherin leshum zevach acher!
Hatane mattitya ben yehuda, kegon shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa.

Aval en zevach zavuach beotah shaa, may? nifsal belina? addetane sefa: im lav yippaslu belina, liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim? shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa, aval en zevach zavuach beotah shaa – lo.
Hachi name ka amar: bamme devarim amurim? shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa, aval en zevach zavuach beotah shaa – naasa kemi shennifselu belina, ufesulin.
Umi it leh lerabbi shimon ben elazar lev bet din matne alehen?
Veha amar rav idi bar avin, amar rav amram, amar rabbi yitzchak, amar rabbi yochanan: temidin shello hutzerchu latztzibbur – ledivre rabbi shimon en nifdin temimim, ledivre chachamim nifdin temimim.
Shane hatam, deit lehu takkanta biriyyay.

Mishna velad toda utemuratah, hifrish toda veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha – enah teuna lechem, shenneemar: "vehikriv al zevach hattoda" – hattoda teuna lechem, velo veladah velo chillufah velo temuratah teunin lechem.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: mahu omer "toda yakriv"? "im al toda yakriv" – minnayin lemafrish todato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, venimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot – minnayin sheeze mehen sheyyirtze yakriv velachmah immah? talmud lomar "hattoda yakriv".

Yachol shettehe sheniyya teuna lechem? talmud lomar "yakrivennu" – echad velo shenayim. achar sheribba hakkatuv umiet, minnayin lerabbot veladot vachalifot utemurot lehakerava? talmud lomar "im al toda". yachol yehu teunot lechem? talmud lomar "vehikriv al zevach hattoda" – toda teuna lechem, velo veladah velo chillufah velo temuratah teunin lechem.
Shelach rav chanina mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella leachar kappara, aval lifne chappara – teunin lechem.
Have ba rav amram: aheyay? illema achalife todat chova – i lifne chappara, tenena! i leachar kappara, tenena!

a: Ella achalife toda nedava, ben lifne chappara ben leachar kappara teunot lechem – marbe betodot hu!
Ella, avvelad toda nedava – ben lifne chappara ben leachar kappara en teunin lechem, motar detoda hi! ella, avvelad toda chova – lifne chappara taun lechem, leachar kappara en taun lechem.
May ka mashma lan, dekasavar rabbi yochanan: adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh. have ba name abbaye ki hay gavvna.

Ittemar name, amar rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar rabbi yochanan: chillufe toda nedava, ben lifne chappara ben leachar kappara – teuna lechem, marbe betodot hu. velad toda nedava, ben lifne chappara ben leachar kappara – en taun lechem, motar detoda hu. vevlad toda chova, lifne chappara – teunin lechem, leachar kappara – en teunin lechem.
Amar shemuel: kol shebbechattat meta – betoda en teuna lechem, kol shebbechattat roa – battoda teuna lechem.

Metiv rav amram: mahu omer "hattoda yakriv"? minnayin lemafrish todato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, venimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot – minnayin sheezo mehen sheyyirtze yakriv velachmah immah? talmud lomar "hattoda yakriv". yachol tehe sheniyya teuna lechem? talmud lomar "yakrivennu" – echad velo shenayim.

Veillu gabbe chattat ki hay gavna roa, ditnan: hifrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, venimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot – mitkapper beachat mehen usheniyya tamut, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: en chattat meta ella shennimtzet leachar shennitkapperu bealim, ha kodem shennitkapperu bealim – roa.
Shemuel kerabbi sevira leh, deamar: avuda bishat haferasha – meta.
Ella roa, lerabbi hechi mashkachat la? kidrabbi oshaya, deamar rabbi oshaya: hifrish shete chattaot leachrayut, mitkapper beeze mehen sheyyirtze, vehashsheniyya tire.
Veha gabbe toda ki hay gavvna en teuna lechem, ella shemuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh, deamar: chamesh chattaot metot.
Veha roa, lerabbi shimon let leh kelal.
Shemuel name chada kaamar: kol shebbechattat meta – betoda en teuna lechem. may ka mashma lan? leappoke midderabbi yochanan, deamar: adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh, kamashma lan dela.
Amar rabbi abba: zo toda vezo lachmah, avad hallechem – mevi lechem acher, avda toda – eno mevi toda acheret. may tama? lechem liglal toda, veen toda liglal lechem.
Veamar rava: hifrish maot letodato
b: Venittotru – mevi bahen lechem. lelachme toda venittotru – en mevi bahen toda.

May tama? illema mishshum derav kahana, deamar rav kahana: minnayin lelachme toda shennikreu "toda"? shenneemar: "vehikriv al zevach hattoda challot matztzot". i hachi, ippecha name! lechem ikkeri "toda", toda la ikkeray "lechem".

Veamar rava: hifrish todato veavda, vechazar vehifrish acheret tachteha, veavda, vechazar vehifrish acheret tachteha, venimtzeu harishonot, vahare sheloshtan omdot. nitkapper barishona – sheniyya enah teuna lechem, shelishit teuna lechem.

Nitkapper bashshelishit – sheniyya enah teuna lechem, rishona teuna lechem; baemtzait – shetehen en teunot lechem; abbaye amar: afillu nitkapper beachat mehen – shetehen en teunot lechem, kullehu chalifin dahadade ninhu.

Amar rabbi zera: vechen leinyan chattaot, hifrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, venimtzeu harishonot, vahare sheloshtan omdot. nitkapper barishona – sheniyya tamut, shelishit tire.
Nitkapper bashshelishit – sheniyya tamut, verishona tire. nitkapper baemtzait – shetehen yamutu. abbaye amar: afillu nitkapper beachat mehen – shetehen yamutu, kullehu chalifin dahadade ninhu.
May "vechen"? mahu detema: hatam hu deikka lememar "marbe betodot hu", aval hacha, delekka lememar "marbe bechattaot hu", ema la. ka mashma lan.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: toda shennitarva bitmuratah, umeta achat mehen – chavertah en lah takkana. hechi naaved? nakrev lechem bahada – dilma temura hi, la nakrev lechem bahada – dilma toda hi.
Hechi dame? i deamar "alay", la saggi dela mayyte leh behema acharina velechem, velema: i hach dekayyma temura hi – ha toda veha lachmah, i hach dekayyma toda hi – ha lachmah veha tehve achrayut!
La tzericha, deamar "hare zo".
(Siman: lemudim, middat, illa, sheyyesh, shekken, dedamah, dei, chalash, motar, temura, bachutz, chizkiyya, hifrish chattat, leachar yoter).
Amru lemedin lifne rabbi: velayte lechem, velema: i hach dekayyma toda hi – ha lachmah, i la – lippok lechullin. amar lehu: vechi machnisin chullin laazara?
Velayte behema velechem, velema: i hach dekayyma temura hi – ha toda veha lachmah, i hach dekayyma toda hi – ha lachmah veha tihve shelamim! amar lehu: mishshum deka memaet baachila dishlamim.

Amar levi lerabbi: velayte behema velechem, velema: i hach dekayyma temura hi – ha toda veha lachmah, vei hay dekayyma toda hi – ha lachmah veha tehve motar detoda! amar leh: kimdumme ani sheen lo moach bekodkodo,

a: Vechi mafrishin techilla lemotarot?

Yatev rabbi yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta kammeh derav nachman, veyatev vekaamar: velayyte behema velechem, velema: i hach dekayyma temura hi – ha toda veha lachmah, vei hach dekayyma toda hi – ha lachmah veha tihve temura.
Amar leh: ani mari, arbein bechatpeh, vechasher?!

Rav illa chalash, al legabbeh abbaye verabbanan, veyatvi veka amri: im ita lidrabbi yochanan deamar: chutz lechomat haazara kadosh, layyte lechem velotva chutz lechomat haazara, velema: i hach dekayyma toda hi – ha lachmah, vei la – lippok lechullin.
Mishshum deikka arba lehanif, hechi lebed? lanfinhu abbaray? "lifne Adonai" ketiv! gavvavy? ka meayyel chullin laazara! hilkach, la efshar.

Matkef la rav shisha bereh derav idi: im ita lidchizkiyya, deamar kadshu arbaim mittoch shemonim – layyte behema, velayyte shemonim bahada, velema: i hach dekayyma toda hi – ha name tehve toda, veha shemonim detarvayyhu; i hach dekayyma temura hi – ha toda veha lachmah, velikdeshu lehu arbaim mittoch shemonim!
Mishshum deka memaet baachila dearbaim.

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: im ita lidrabbi yochanan, deamar: hifrish chattat meubberet veyalda – ratza bah mitkapper, ratza bivvladah mitkapper, layyte behema meubberet veyamtin lah ad shetteled, velayyte shemonim bahada, velema: i hach dekayyma temura hi – ha uveladah toda hi, veha shemonim detarvavyyhu; vei hach dekayyma toda hi – ha name toda hi, veha shemonim detarvavyyhu hu, vehay leheve motar detoda.
Amar leh: man lema lan deamar rabbi yochanan im shiyyeyro meshuyyayr? dilma im shiyyeyro eno meshuyyayr, vehayeynu tama derabbi yochanan, deamar: adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh.

Ravina ikkela ledamhavrya, amar leh rav dimi bereh derav huna middamhavrya leravina: velayyte behema, velema "hare alay", velayyte behema achariti, velayyte shemonim bahada, velema: i hach dekayyma temura hi – hane tarte todot, veha shemonim detarvayyhu; vei hach dekayyma toda hi – veha deamri "alay" name leheve toda, veha shemonim detarvayyhu, veiddach tihve leachrayut.
Amar leh: hattora amra "tov asher lo tiddor mishshettiddor velo teshallem", veat amrat: lekum velindor battechilla?!
Mishna haomer "hare alay toda" – yavi hi velachmah min hachullin.
b: "Toda alay min hachullin velachmah min hammaaser" – yavi hi velachmah min hachullin. "toda min hammaaser velachmah min hachullin" – yavi. "hi velachmah min hammaaser" – yavi. velo yavi mechitte maaser sheni, ella mimmeot maaser sheni.

Gemara amar rav huna: haomer "hare alay lachme toda" – mevi toda velachmah. may tama? midda yada hay gavra delechem belo toda la ykarev, vehay toda velachmah kaamar, vehay dekaamar "lachme toda" – sof milleta naket.
Tenan: toda min hammaaser velachmah min hachullin – yavi kema shennadar. veammay? kevan deamar "lachmah min hachullin" – yavi hi velachmah min hachullin!
Shane hatam, dechevan deamar "toda min hammaaser", naasa keomer "hare alay lechem liftor todato shel peloni".
I hachi, resha dekatane: toda min hachullin velachmah min hammaaser – yavi hi velachmah min hachullin, hacha name naasa keomer "hare alay toda liftor lachmo shel peloni"!
Hachi hasheta? bishlama lechem lemiftar toda ate, toda lemiftar lechem mi atya?
Ta shema: haomer "hare alay toda belo lechem" vezevach belo nesachim" – kofin oto, umevi toda velachmah, zevach unesachim.
Tama deamar, aval la amar toda – la.
Hu haddin af al gav dela amar "toda", veayyeyde deka bae lemitne "zevach belo nesachim", dela mittene leh "nesachim belo zevach", tena name "toda".
Ammay? neder ufitcho immo hu!
Amar chizkiyya: ha manni? bet shammay hi, deamri: tefos lashon harishon. ditnan: "hareni nazir min haggerogrot umin haddevela" – bet shammay omrim: nazir, uvet hillel omrim: eno nazir.
Rabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema bet hillel, beomer: illu hayiti yodea sheen nodrin kach, lo hayiti noder kach, ella kach. umay kofin? deka bae hadar beh.

Ta shema: haomer "hare alay toda belo lechem", vezevach belo nesachim", veamru lo: "have toda velachmah", vezevach unesachim", veomer: "illu hayiti yodea shekken lo hayiti noder" – kofin oto, veomer lo: "shemor veshamata".
Bishlama lechizkiyya, nicha leh, ella lerabbi yochanan kashya! amar lach rabbi yochanan: ha vadday bet shammay hi.
May "shemor veshamata"? amar abbaye: "shemor" – have toda, "veshamata" – have lachmah. rava amar: "shemor" – have toda velachmah, "veshamata" – shello tehe ragil laasot ken.
"Toda hi velachmah min hammaaser" – yavi. yavi? la saggi dela mayyte? rav nachman verav chisda amri: ratza mevi, lo ratza lo yavi.
Velo yavi mechitte maaser sheni, ella mimmeot maaser sheni. rav nachman verav chisda deamri tarvayyhu: lo shanu ella mechitte maaser sheni, aval mechittin hallekuchot mimmeot maaser sheni – yavi.

Yatev rabbi yirmeya kammeh derabbi zera, veyatev vekaamar: lo shanu ella mechitte maaser sheni, aval mechittin hallekuchot bimot maaser sheni – yavi. amar leh: rabbi, atta omer ken? ani omer afillu mechittin hallekuchot bimot maaser sheni lo yavi. veema tama didi, veema tama didach. ema tama didach: toda mehecha ka yalfat la? mishshelamim,
